2.3. ade_auftragsarten
Table name: ade_auftragsarten Product: BDE
Designation: Order types Description: Order types
Order types are issued to structure the orders in accordance with their use. Each order type
includes various control information that is decisive when managing orders.
# Key
auftrag_art
# Connections to other tables
auftrags_bestand, ade_status_zuord, hybuch
Column name Column designation Type Description
a_an_sk_beginn Logging OP on again at shift start char(1) This identifier defines operation logon behavior at the start of a shift.
J: Interrupt operation and automatically log operation back on at start of shift.
N: Do not log an operation back on at start of shift. Interrupt only.
X: The processing depends on the appropriate setting in the workplace/ machine
configuration
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:AANSKBAUTO)
a_p_an Combined order logon char(1) Combined order logon
This identifier is used for displaying "overhead cost operations".
J: With this order type operation and person are firmly connected with each other.
The performance (posting of operation and person) is as it is the case when logging on to a group workplace
The person is not connected with other operations at the machine
The booked manual quantity is always posted onto the reporting person
The reporting person (A_TR/A_UN/A_AB) also has to be logged on to the operation
IMPORTANT: with this option pers_abmeld always has to be = "N" to prevent the operation from being continued without
person!
T: No overhead cost processing. Use terminal or machine settings
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:APAN)
aend_rueckmeld Change after upload char(1) Change after upload
This identifier defines how changes/ corrections to postings uploaded to the ERP/PPS system are handled. The identifier is
evaluated during posting maintenance as well as during event
maintenance.
J: Changes/ corrections are allowed to already uploaded postings; changes are
also uploaded to the PPS system.
E: Changes/ corrections are allowed to already uploaded postings; however,
these corrections are not uploaded to the PPS system.
N: No more changes/ corrections are allowed to already uploaded postings.
Previously: setup.bde_kz:
[6] J = suppress correction booking for superior system HYDRA.OPT:KORRRMNGEN
[7] J = Maintenance function blocked for uploaded data HYDRA.OPT:EDITBRMSPERR
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:EDITRM)
aktiv Active char(1) If this indicator is set, then this order type is available and can be used. The indicator is checked when an order is first created
or modified.
J: indicator is set
N: indicator is not set
(PDM field ID: AUART.AKTIV)
ap_gedruckt Check that shop floor papers are printed char(1) This setting can activate a validation check during login of operations depending on the print status of the time tickets. Under
the proper conditions, this function can help prevent erroneous postings or rather can "guide" production.
J: An operation may only be logged on if its shop floor papers were printed before (if AUFTRAGS_STATUS.AP_GEDRUCKT =
"J")
N: No validation check
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:APPRN)
auftrag_art Order type char(5) Definition of the order type.
Order types are configured as it is the case in SAP.
The parameters of this configuration control, among other things, performance within the system.
(PDM field ID: AUART.AUART)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 29

auftragsverbuchung Not used at the moment char(4) Not used at the moment
auto_a_ab_vanr_l Milestone processing char(1) Milestone processing for the last operation only - according to the configuration in the corresponding processing code.
J: operation is finished automatically only if it is the last operation within this order (ab.last_afo =J)
N: all operations up to next milestone are finished automatically
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:AUTOAABVANRL)
bearb Last editor char(10) Last editor
bearb_date Last editing date date Last editing date
bearb_time Last editing time integer Last editing time
letzter Bearbeitungszeitpunkt
beendbar May operations of the order be finished char(1) May operations of the order be finished
J: Yes, operations may be finished
S: Checking the status of predecessor operation. In this case, the status of the predecessor operation must have the identifier
"successor can be logged off" set.
N: No, operations may not be finished. A validation check is done when an operation is logged off.
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:ABE)
berecht_pflege Authorization key for editing recorded data char(4) This authorization key allows to control which user may edit recorded data for which order type.
Add this key to a user in user administration in order to control if this user is allowed to edit recorded data for specific order
types only. If no key is assigned to a user, this user can edit stock data for all order types.
To avoid collisions with existing authorization keys it is recommended to use a prefix which is defininitely not used in function
authorizations yet (e.g. $)
(PDM field ID: AUART.FKT:EDIT)
berecht_stufe Authorization key for editing stock data char(4) This authorization key allows to control which user may edit stock data for which order type.
Add this key to a user in user administration in order to control if this user is allowed to edit stock data for specific order types
only. If no key is assigned to a user, this user can edit stock data for all order types.
To avoid collisions with existing authorization keys it is recommended to use a prefix which is defininitely not used in function
authorizations yet (e.g. $)
(PDM field ID: AUART.FKT)
bereich CAQ area char(15) Not used at the moment
(PDM field ID: AUART.BER)
bezeichnung Designation char(60) Designation of the order type
(PDM field ID: AUART.BEZL)
dialogsteuerung Dialog control char(10) Dialog control that deviates from how the system typically behaves and it can
be referenced accordingly in the dynamic dialog. This makes it possible to show or hide situation specific input fields at the
terminal.
Please note:
This setting can also be defined at the workplace (machine/ workplace
configuration). When a terminal dialog is opened, dialog control for both
order type and workplace are considered. For this reason, we recommend
that dialog control be defined either in the order type or at the workplace.
(PDM field ID: AUART.DLGSTRG)
erfassbar Recordable char(1) This identifier defines whether operations for orders of this order type can be recorded, i.e. posted.
J: Yes, operations can be recorded.
Whether an operation is really recordable also depends on the setting with the
same name in the processing code.
N: No; Operations may not be recorded. An attempt to log any such operation on
is rejected with a validation error.
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:ERF)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 30

ermittlung_fertvar Consider production variants char(2) Consider production variants
[1,1] when transferring an operation
E: The system determines whether a valid production variant exists at the time the
operation is transferred/ created.
P: At the time an operation is transferred/ created, the data transferred is checked only
to verify that it matches a valid production variant (validation check).
N: No determination/ validation check
[2,2] in planning (shop floor scheduling / HLS)
E: Determination. A valid production variant is determined at the time an operation
is planned in graphic planning.
P: Checking only. At the time of planning, the data transferred is checked only to verify that it matches a valid production
variant (validation check). Default values are not taken over from the production variant.
G: Group-specific testing. At the time of planning, the data transferred is checked to verify that it matches a valid production
variant (validation check). But the checking
is only performed within the group defined for the operation. Default values are not taken over from the production variant.
N: Not used.
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:FERTVAR)
kategorie Category char(2) Mandatory field
Classification is a logical term for similar order types
FA: Production order. Standard production orders created e.g. by an interface.
PJ: Project order. Projects are, among others, characterized by their uniqueness. The project steps that are to be performed
as a part of a project can be combined in a project order
PM: Maintenance order. Orders that have been designed for the planning or collection of maintenance measures
KP: Capacity order. Orders that have been designed for capacity
reservations in the shop floor scheduling module (HLS).
GK: Overhead cost order. Orders for the collection of overhead costs.
They may also be included in evaluations.
ATTENTION: No processing or posting using these values. For this purpose use the configurations at order type or processing
code.
(PDM field ID: AUART.KAT)
keine_au_abmeld Order is not logged off automatically char(1) Processing can take place subject to the termination of the order (header). Using this identifier can prevent the order from
being set to finished if the last recordable operation was finished.
N: Finishing all recordable operations automatically sets the order to finished (setting
order status using the control indicator "E")
J: Order is not logged off automatically, i.e. finishing all recordable operations does not
automatically set the order to finished.
(PDM field ID: AUART.OPT:NAUTOABAU)
masch_plaus Check for specifications in backlog of orders char(1) Check for specifications in backlog of orders
The fields from SETUP get to the order type configuration: setup.masch_plaus:
J: An operation logon is only allowed at the planned workplace
G: An operation logon is allowed only to the planned workplace, to a workplace belonging to the group or to a workplace
planned for the group.
K: An operation logon is possible either to the planned workplace or to aworkplace of the same category
N: No validation check
S: Group control
ATTENTION: "planned" has been redefined in version 7.2
(PDM field ID: AUART.PLAUS:MNR)
max_pers_plaus Check against M/O relation when person char(1) Check against M/O relation when person logs on
logs on J: Machine/operator relation (MB_VERHAELTNIS). When a person logs on to an operation, a check is run to determine if the
maximum number of employees has already been reached. If this is the case, this personnel logon is rejected.
N: No check
K: Component list of requirements to be transferred (planned, currently not used)
(PDM field ID: AUART.PLAUS:PNR)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 31

Only OPs of the same order type can be logged on simultaneously
J/N

opt_planung Miscellaneous flags regarding planning char(10) [1,1]
Use setup time indicated in shop floor scheduling

J/N
pers_abmeld Pers_abmelden char(1) Persons are logged off automatically when the shift ends

X: The processing depends on the relevant setting in the workplace/ machine configuration

pflege_tr Editing of scrap incl. reason in maintenance char(1) Keeping scrap explanation in the booking maintenance
of postings (PDM field ID: AUART.EDITTR)
planen Planning char(1) Decides whether or how orders of this type are relevant for detailed scheduling.
N: No planning (not transferred to planning component)
T: Scheduling only. The order is scheduled, that is the lead time is calculated based on the process
times and the dates are set accordingly. No competitive situations are considered during (lead time) scheduling.
F: Scheduling and detailed scheduling (dispatching). The order is relevant for detailed planning and is consequently - in
addition to scheduling - considered during automatic and/ or interactive planning.
Please note: During automatic dispatch (detailed scheduling), operations are dispatched to a workplace. In the process, the
situation pertaining to capacity and assignment is considered for the workplace, which may result in the inability to dispatch by
the planned date determined from lead time scheduling.

prio_steuerung Priority control char(2) Priority control
[1,1]:
Priority Control
U: Priority control is order-related, i.e. the priority is set in the order (header) and has an impact on all OPs.
G: Priority control is operation related
[2,2]:
Activation of priority management
J: Orders of this order type are taken into account for priority management, i.e. when changing/creating an order it is checked
whether the assigned priority is admissible or not and in case the maximum number is violated, the action is rejected (affects
the console). The "order group" field is a mandatory field in this case.
N: Orders of this order type are not considered during priority management.
Prioritätsteuerung
PRIO_STEUERUNG[1,1]:
U = Priorität wird Auftragsbezogen geführt, d.h. die Priorität wird am Auftrag gesetzt und schlägt sich auf alle AGs nieder.
G = Priorität wird Vorgangs-/AG-bezogen geführt
à Standard
PRIO_STEUERUNG[2,2]:
Aktivieren der Prioritätsverwaltung
J = Aufträge dieser Auftragsart werden bei der Prioritätenverwaltung berücksichtigt. D.h. beim Ändern/ Neuanlegen eines
Auftrags wird geprüft, ob die vergebene Priorität zulässig ist und bei Verletzung der maximalen Anzahl die Aktion abgelehnt
(betrifft die Konsole). Das Feld "Auftragsgruppe" ist in diesem Fall ein Pflichtfeld
N = Aufträge dieser Auftragsart werden bei der Prioritätenverwaltung nicht berücksichtigt; das Feld "Auftragsgruppe" ist in
diesem Fall ein Kannfeld.
Mögliche Werte
OPT:PRIOVRW= "UJ", "UN", "GN"

absprung Branch OP char(40) OP, from which it is "branched off"; as stored in SAP

(PDM field ID: AFOLG.AUNR)
ausrichtung Alignment char(1) Key by means of which you can control how a parallel sequence is scheduled with respect to the date.
If there are several parallel sequences the lead times differ in length. Thus, temporal buffers result in the sequences. Due to
the alignment, it is controlled whether these buffers are at the beginning or the end of the sequence. Possible values:
"F" alignment at the earliest date (buffer lies at the end of the sequence)
"S" alignment at the latest date (buffer lies at the beginning of the sequence)
"N" not relevant
SAP: AUSCHL CHAR(1)
Plausibility check:
· only relevant in case of parallel sequence; "F" or "S" has to be entered.
· in case of a standard sequence and alternative sequences, a transferred value is ignored and "N" is entered.

- there can be several sequences per AU

A sequence of operations that can be used as an alternative to a number of consecutive operations from the standard
sequence. Alternative sequences are used, for example, if the production process differs according to lot size.

2.15. ade_status_zuord
Table name: ade_status_zuord Product: BDE
Designation: Assignment of order status Description: Order status assignment
Assignment of different order statuses to the various order types.
# Key
status, statustyp, auftrag_art
# Connections to other tables
ade_auftragsarten, ade_status_texte
Column name Column designation Type Description
a_stufe Authorization level char(3) Required authorization (level) to set a status manually.
This is especially required for setting the preparation status manually but can also be used for other status.
(PDM field ID: AST.ASTUFE)
aend_s_status Change of secondary status allowed char(1) Change of secondary status allowed (J/N)
May the secondary status of an operation be changed if this order or operation status is available?
While checking, the order status indicator as well as the operation status indicator have to be taken into account (for both
statuses the flags have to be set to "J")
This flag has to be considered for the processing of the preparation status
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:ASTS)
aenderbar Alterable char(1) With this status the order or OP may be/may no longer be changed manually or by the PPS system.
If this status is set, the order or the operation may either be altered by the PPS system or manually or it may no longer be
altered.
J: office client and MLE interface (PPS=J) alterable
N: office client and MLE interface not alterable
K: Only office client alterable (not via the MLE interface)
M: Only MLE interface alterable (not via the console)
This option does not refer to the priority, notes, long texts, secondary statuses.
(PDM field ID: AST.PLAUS:EDIT)
aktion Action used for the status char(10) Action used for the status
e.g. L = Log on operation
Status can be set optionally when loggin on an operation
empty: default
L: Running
S: Other
Not used at the moment.
(PDM field ID: AST.AKTION)
aktion_vererben Inheritance action for dependent operations char(1) Inheritance rule for dependent operations
Not processed at the moment.
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:AKTIONVERERB)
anmeldbar Can be logged on char(1) Can be logged on (J/N)
Check to assure if the CURRENT status has set this indicator. If the operation is interrupted/
finished, the field is ignored.
Please note: If an OP or an order have been set with the flag "locked", then the OP may not be
logged on under any circumstances (irrespective of this setting)
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:AAN)
auftrag_art Order type char(5) Order type the status is configured for.
The order status is configured based on the order type. This means that for each order type the relevant
order and operation statuses must be defined. Enter a valid order type in this field, for which the
status should apply.
(PDM field ID: AST.AUART)
bearb Last editor char(10) Last editor
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 61

bearb_date Last editing date date Last editing date
bearb_time Last editing time integer Last editing time
bmk_nr Posting RPA smallint RPA the order duration is posted to if VERBUCHUNG = A (1-12)
The RPA of the status that is currenlty available at the machine does not play a role in this context.
Currently not used
(PDM field ID: AST.BMKNR)
farbe Color smallint Color of the relevant status (text). At this time, this color is only used in shop floor scheduling (HLS).
(PDM field ID: AST.COLOR)
folgentausch Sequence change char(1) Sequence change allowed (J/N)
Definition whether sequences may be changed for this order status or whether it is no longer allowed.
Only relevant if sequences are in use.
Currently not used
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:FOLG)
freigabe_nachf_ag Release of subsequent operation char(1) Release of subsequent OP (J/N)
If this indicator is set, then setting the status will result in the status of the subsequent OP(s) being set to the release status,
i.e. set to the status assigned with the control indicator "V".
This only happens if the subsequent OP(s) has (have) not yet been run, was (were) interrupted or has (have) been finished.
Thus, this option only makes sense if new operations are not created/ transferred using the status with the control indicator
"V".
Please note: As opposed to processing up to ADE 7.1, the release is no longer given as a result of automatically scheduling
the operation to a planned workplace, but instead only by setting the aforementioned release status.
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:ANRNFREIG)
init Initial status during creation char(1) Initial status during creation (J/N)
The status having this flag is marked as the initial status that is to be set when a new order (A) or OP (G, S, R) is created.
Exactly one status must be set using this indicator for both the order as well as the operation.
Please note: If the initial status is not the status with the control indicator "V", then the status of the first operation as well as
that of the order is set using the control indicator "V" after the first scheduling, provided that the indicator "Scheduling without
implicit order release" is not set at the order type.
Status can be set manually
(PDM field ID: AST.EAST)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 62

loeschaktion Delete action char(1) Behavior indicating how the order or the operation should respond during the deletion process, i.e. at the time of deletion
(now) or when a deletion flag is triggered:
ORDER
L: If something is physically deleted and all operations are physically deleted as well (order header controls the behavior)
E: Order is set to the status with the control indicator "E".
WARNING: Only the order header, i.e. for the OPs the indicator must also be set!
D: Order is set to status with control indicator "D" and is deleted/ archived using the archiving/ deletion program (data
management) after the set period. How
the operations are treated is described via the indicator RESET ACTION (LOESCHAKTION) at the status of each OP.
X: If the action was triggered by the MLE interface: Order is set to the status with the control indicator "E".
WARNING: Only the order header, i.e. for the OPs the indicator must also be set!
If the action was NOT triggered by the MLE interface: If something is physically deleted and all operations are physically
deleted as well (order header controls the behavior)
OPERATION
L: Is physically deleted.
D: Is set to the status with the control indicator "D".
E: OP is set to the status with the control indicator "E" (fixed).
X: If the action was triggered by the MLE interface: OP is set to the status with the control indicator "E" (fixed).
If the action was NOT triggered by the MLE interface: OP is physically deleted.
The reset/deletion action should be the same for both the order header as well as for the OPs, because currently the settings
each relate to the order or to OPs and the OPs do not "inherit" anything from their order header.
To assure that an order or an operation can no longer be deleted as of a certain status, the indicator must be set at all
corresponding statuses.
(PDM field ID: AST.DELVERB)
loeschbar Deletable char(1) May the order or the operation be deleted in this status (manually, via PPS system)? (J/N)
ORDER
J: Yes, BUT only if the operations can be deleted, i.e. at no operation may a status be set that has a
control indicator "L” AND for which the "deletable" indicator is set to "N".
N: No deletion allowed
OPERATION
J: If the OP is running, then the deletion flag is set.
N: No deletion allowed
Please note: Operations with a current status with a control indicator "L" or "F" may as a rule not be deleted, irrespective of this
setting.
(PDM field ID: AST.PLAUS:DEL)
manuell_setzbar Status can be set manually char(1) Status can be set manually (J/N)
The status can/may be changed manually, i.e. set.
J is only allowed if "SO" (blank) is entered in the production indicator (PROD_KENN) field of the operation; otherwise the field
is to be assigned to "N" and read-only!!
For the preparation status the field is always assigned to "J" and read-only!
To be considered for manual status changes.
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:MANU)
mat_bmk_nr RPA for material bookings smallint RPA for material bookings (1-12)
Currently not used
(PDM field ID: AST.MAT:BMK)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 63

nachfolg_abmeldbar Successor can be logged off char(1) Successor can be logged off (J/N)
If the indicator "Can be finished" ("Entry" index tab) is set to “S" = status at the order type, then this indicator is used to check
whether the subsequent OP can be logged off.
The indicator relates to the preceding OP!
Example 1: If an OP logoff of the subsequent OP is not to be allowed until the preceding OP has also at least begun, then this
indicator must be set to "J" (y – yes) if the status is "running", "interrupted" or "finished".
Example 2: If an OP logoff of the subsequent OP is not to be allowed until the preceding OP has finished, then this indicator
needs only to be set if the status is "finished" .
All preceding OPs resulting from relationships in ADE_AUFTRAGSNETZ, are checked in this regard.
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:ANRNAAB)
nachfolg_anmeldbar Successor can be logged on char(1) Successor can be logged on (J/N)
If the indicator "Check of preceding OP" ("Plausibilities" index tab) is set to “S" = status at the order type, then this indicator is
used to check whether the subsequent OP can be logged on.
The indicator relates to the preceding OP!
If, for example, an OP logon of the subsequent OP is not to be allowed until the preceding OP has at least begun, then this
indicator must be set if the status is "running", "interrupted", "finished" (possibly "deleted").
If, for example, an OP logon of the subsequent OP is not to be allowed until the preceding OP has finished, then this indicator
needs only to be set if the status is "finished" (possibly "deleted").
All preceding OPs resulting from relationships in ADE_AUFTRAGSNETZ, are checked in this regard.
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:ANRNAAN)
opt_erfassung char(10) free
opt_planung char(10) free
p_bmk_nr RPA for person bookings smallint RPA for person bookings (1-12)
(PDM field ID: AST.PNR:BMK)
planen Planning char(1) Planning
N: No planning (no transfer to the planning component)
T: Scheduling only
F: Scheduling and detailed planning (dispatching) - also includes the simulation
The indicator "N" at the order overrides the indicator at the operations. Conversely, the indicators at the operations override
the indicator "J" at the order
--> to be considered for: shop floor scheduling / Detailed scheduling
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:PLAN)
prio_pruefung Check for priority char(1) Check for priority (J/N)
When an order is newly created/ modified, the system checks it against priority management (order group). For this evaluation,
all orders with statuses assigned to this indicator are checked.
Please note: The priority check is only performed for order/ operation modifications if the priority was actually changed during
the modification process.
(PDM field ID: AST.PLAUS:PRIO)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 64

prod_kenn Control indicator char(2) Control / Production indicator
Status type A (order status)
V: Prepared. Release (for automatic release)
L: In process. At least one OP was started
E: Finished. All OPs are finished or deleted.
S: None. All others
Status type G (OP status)
V: Prepared. "Release indicator" for status; before OP is edited for the first time
L: Running. Is set automatically once OP is logged on
U: Interrupted. Is set automatically once OP is interrupted
F: Autom. interrupted. Is set by the server if you want the OP to be interrupted automatically at the time of a shift change
(when using the MDE function at the terminal)
E: Finished. Is set automatically once OP is finished
S: None. Other status; not automatically set. Means that no work has yet been done on the OP
An OP has not yet begun if its status is set with a control indicator: "V" or "S".
Explicitly setting an order to the status using the control indicator "E" will result in all OPs being set to the status with the
control indicator "E".
The control indicator "A" means "archived"; it is not set via configuration, but is instead a fixed setting made at the time the
data are transferred into the long-term table.
Except for "S", there must be exactly 1 status with this indicator for each order type
To be considered for
- automatic setting of predecessor status (e.g. A_AN, A_UN)
- manual setting of predecessor status
- Automatic finishing of predecessor OP
- Automatic release (after lead time scheduling)
- deletion processing (as a precaution)
(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:PKENN)
res_bmk_nr RPA for resource bookings smallint RPA for resource bookings (1-12)

status Status char(5) This is the externally valid status

status_vererben Inheritance rule for dependent operations char(1) Inheritance rule for dependent OPs

(PDM field ID: AST.OPT:STAVERERB)
statustext_nr Status text No. integer Reference to the order status text table

statustyp Status type char(1) Status type
A: Status refers to the (entire) order
G: Status refers to the operation

(PDM field ID: AST.ASTTYP)

symbol Symbol char(12) Symbol assigned to the status. It is displayed in different functions/ evaluations (e.g. order overview).
The following values are allowed (case sensitive):
l.bmp: light green led

v.bmp: gray led

2.16. ade_verarb_codes

| Table name: ade_verarb_codes  |     | Product: BDE                  |     |     |
| ----------------------------- | --- | ----------------------------- | --- | --- |
| Designation: Processing codes |     | Description: Processing codes |     |     |
A processing code is a collection of options that are used to control the operations. Each operation
references this kind of processing code, and as a result its performance is defined in relation to planning,
collection or posting.
# Key
verarb_code
# Connections to other tables
auftrags_bestand, arbplan_bestand
| Column name | Column designation | Type | Description |     |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ---- | ----------- | --- |

Default = J

auto_a_ab_menge Terminate OP when reaching target quantity char(4) An OP is automatically logged off from the workplace when the produced quantity equals the target quantity.
In case of operations that are logged on to several workplaces, the operation cannot be logged off automatically when the
target quantity is reached. This means that the operation is only logged off from the workplace at which you identified that the
target quantity is reached. The operation is not logged off from other workplaces (that are
logged on in parallel).
[1,1]
Automatic Logoff
When calculating the quantity produced, the items of the option "Consider additionally when terminating" (see below --> [2,2]-
[4,4]) are taken into account. If none of the options is set, the quantity produced is derived from the yield only (primary quantity
unit).
Corresponds to value in auftrags_bestand.abmeldopt[3,3]
Possible values:
N: No automatic logoff when target quantity is reached (default)
J: Automatic logoff when target quantity is reached
U: Automatic interruption when target quantity is reached
F: Automatic logoff and logon of subsequent OP with identical article number. The operation that should be logged on is the
operation that is planned next at this workplace (the selection criterion is the planned start of the operation at the workplace). If
the article number is identical to the article number of the logged off operation, this operation is logged on to the workplace. If
the article number of the operation planned next is not identical to the article number of the logged off operation, the operation
is not logged on.
K: Campaign control. Automatic logoff and logon of subsequent OP of the same campaign (only relevant in connection with
the grouping function of Shop Floor Scheduling, license HLS-KPG).
[2,2]
Consider additionally when terminating: scrap
Scrap is additionally taken into account when an operation is finished.
This option is integrated in both options "Terminate OP when reaching target quantity" and "Terminate preceding OP". A
subsequent change of this option in the processing code has no effect on already existing operations.
Possible Values: J/N
[3,3]
Consider additionally when terminating: rework
The rework quantity is additionally taken into account when an operation is finished
This option is integrated in both options "Terminate OP when reaching target quantity" and "Terminate preceding OP". A
subsequent change of this option in the processing code has no effect on already existing operations.
Possible Values: J/N
[4,4]
Consider additionally when terminating: open quantity
The open quantity is additionally taken into account when an operation is finished
This option is integrated in both options "Terminate OP when reaching target quantity" and "Terminate preceding OP". A
subsequent change of this option in the processing code has no effect on already existing operations.
Possible Values: J/N
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOAABMENGE)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 69

auto_a_ab_vanr Terminate predecessor OP char(1) Termination of predecessor OPs until the next start of a milestone (included) ("milestone processing")
If an operation with the enabled option "Terminate preceding OP" in the processing code is logged off (posting A_AB) or
terminated (posting A_BE), all directly preceding operations within the order network of the operation are terminated.
It depends on the respective status, if the preceding operations are logged off.
· Logged on operations are logged off (posting A_AB)
· Interrupted operations are terminated (posting A_BE)
J: All preceding OPs are automatically terminated when the OP is logged off without quantity posting (logged on OPs only if
"External processing" is set).
M: All preceding OPs are automatically terminated when the OP is logged off while the remaining quantity is automatically
posted. When calculating the quantity produced, the items of the option "Consider additionally when terminating" (see below)
are taken into account. If none of the options is set, then the remaining quantity is derived from the difference of target quantity
minus yield (primary quantity unit in each case).
N: No automatic finish
j_: All preceding OPs are terminated automatically when the OP is logged off without quantity posting (including logged on
OPs).
m_: All preceding OPs are finished automatically when the OP is logged off while the remaining quantity is automatically
posted (including logged on OPs).
All preceding operations are logged off or terminated up to the operation that has the option "Beginning of milestone" set in the
processing code. If the option is not checked, the processing continues up to the first operation of the order. The processing is
performed asynchronously.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOAABVANR)
auto_a_an_vanr Automatic logon by predecessor OP char(1) Automatic logon by predecessor OP (J/N)
During OP logon, the system automatically logs on all direct subsequent OPs to the planned workplace that include this
enabled option. If the operation has not yet been planned for a workplace, the operation is logged on to the first workplace of
the group (workplace with the lowest number).
Please note: A subsequent change of this option in the processing code has no effect on already
existing operations.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOAANVANR)
auto_a_un_ab Interrupt/terminate OP char(1) Interrupt OP instead of terminating it
U: When the OP is manually logged off, it is not terminated, but instead it is simply interrupted
B: Terminate OP instead of interrupting it
E/N/empty: No use
This option should not be used in combination with the options "Terminate preceding OPs".
If this option is used in combination with the option "Terminate OP when reaching target quantity", the option "Interrupt OP
instead of terminating it" will take priority, i.e. the OP/OPs is/are not terminated but are simply interrupted.
A subsequent change of this option in the processing code has no effect on already existing operations. This is because when
creating a new operation, the value is initialized with value in auftrags_bestand.abmeldopt[1,1]
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOAUNAB)
auto_a_un_vanr Automatic transfer of interruption to char(1) Automatic transfer of an interruption to the preceding OPs up to the next beginning of milestone. A subsequent change of this
preceding OP option in the processing code has no effect on already existing operations.
U: Automatic interruption of all predecessor OPs when interrupting the OP
N: No automatic interruption of predecessor OP
All predecessor OPs are interrupted or finished until that OP for which the "milestone start" indicator is set to "J" within the
processing code. If it is not set, processing continues to the first OP.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOAUNVANR)
auto_caq_ab Logoff by main OP char(1) Logoff by main OP
This parameter is only available with operations that are linked to a main operation.
J: The moment the main operation is logged off or interrupted, the system automatically tries to log off or interrupt all linked
operations.
N:The moment the main operation is logged off or interrupted, the system does not try to log off or interrupt all linked
operations.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOCAQAB)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 70

auto_caq_an Logon by main OP char(1) Logon by main OP
This parameter is only available with operations that are linked to a main operation.
J: The moment the main operation is logged on, the system automatically tries to log on all linked operations.
The configurations of the variable workplaces are taken into account when the workplaces to which the linked operations
should be logged on to are identified.
N: The moment the main operation is logged on, the linked operations are automatically logged on as well.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AUTOCAQAN)

caq_ag Inspection OP char(1) Inspection OP (J/N)
This field identifies a QM operation. This kind of operation is not uploaded to a leading system once finished. And if configured
accordingly, the system automatically finishes such operations once a related inspection step is finished.
J: Operations assigned to this processing code are pure inspection operations. These operations only have quality control
purposes and do not generate output of semi-finished or finished products.
N: Operations assigned to this processing code are not pure inspection operations. These operations generate output of semi-
finished or finished products.

chargen_pflicht Batch management requirement char(1) Batch management requirement (J/N)
If this option is checked, the batch management is required for this OP (only relevant for ADE-CHV or MPL).

erfassbar Recordable char(1) This identifier defines whether operations for orders of this order type can be recorded or not, i.e. posted as defined in BDE
(shop floor data collection).
J: Yes, operations can be recorded as defined in BDE. Whether an operation is really recordable also depends on the setting
with the same name in the Order types.
N: The operation is for information purposes only ("info operation") and may not be posted as defined in BDE. An attempt to
log on any such operation is rejected with a validation error.
Please note:
1) To ensure that an operation does not appear in the sequencing list on the terminal, the option sequencing list (see below)
should be disabled.
2) An info OP is automatically finished with the end of the subsequent OP. Requirement: the operation is planned for a
machine that "may be posted".
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:ERF)
freigabe Release of rework OP char(1) Release of the rework operation (P/N)
If this option is enabled, the initial status in status assignment is ignored and the status of the operation is set to the control
indicator "V" when an operation is initially created or transferred from the PPS system. Necessary PRE-CONDITION: The
preceding operation in the sequence must be finished; i.e. it currently is assigned a status with control indicator "E"
If this flag is explicitly set to "P" (like problem) the initial status is ignored within status configuration when ANR.INSERT and
the OP is set to the status with production characteristic = "V" BUT ONLY IF the predecessor OP has not yet been finished in
the sequence, i.e. its prod_kenn is <> "E".
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:FREIG)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 71

fremdbearbeitung External processing OP char(1) This identifier defines whether the operation is an internal or external processing operation.
J: The operation is processed externally. If this option is active, detailed scheduling is automatically INACTIVE. For such
operations the lead time is only scheduled from the delivery time.
N: The operation is processed in-house.
For such operations capacity requirements result from process times:
-> setup time (fixed and dynamic setup time)
-> processing time
-> teardown time
All process times listed in the following are considered for lead time scheduling:
-> waiting time
-> setup time (fixed and dynamic setup time)
-> processing time
-> inspection time
-> teardown time
-> wait time
-> transport time
-> both, to avoid differentiation
Please note: If this option is active, the identifier Planning should be set to either "T" or "N".
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:FREMDFERT)
mehrfach_kz Parallel logon possible char(1) Parallel logon possible for this OP

N: An operation with this processing code may be logged on only once

meilensteinbeginn Beginning of milestone char(1) This option is relevant in connection with the option "Terminate preceding OPs" (DB field AUTO_A_AB_VANR). Therefore the

BAPI: transfered to auftrags_bestand.abmeldopt[8,8]

menge_pri_uebli Overdelivery float Overdelivery is allowed for this operation. The value entered is a percentage of the target quantity.
Whether overdelivery is allowed or not, results from MENGE_PRI_UEBLI_R and the percentage.
The values in field MENGENPRUEFUNG define which values should be included besides yield.
Example: For a target quantity of 100 pieces and an allowed overdelivery of a maximum of 120 pieces, the value 120 must be
entered here.
Overdelivery is checked when the operation is logged off or interrupted, and also when a partial quantity is
confirmed/uploaded.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.MENGEPROZ:UEBLI)
menge_pri_uebli_r Reaction to overdelivery char(1) Reaction to overdelivery
empty: Tolerance is not checked
X; Error which is created if the tolerance quantity defined as percentage in the above-mentioned field Overdelivery is not
reached or exceeded. This validation check may not be overridden by a mandatory posting.
W: Warning if tolerance quantity is exceeded or not reached. This validation check may be overridden by a mandatory posting
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:UEBLIR)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 72

menge_pri_untli Underdelivery float Underdelivery is allowed for this operation. The value entered is a percentage of the target quantity.
Whether overdelivery is allowed or not, results from MENGE_PRI_UNTLI_R and the percentage.
The fields described below in the section Consider additionally in case of inspections define which values should be included
besides yield.
Example: For a target quantity of 100 pieces and an allowed underdelivery of at least 80 pieces, the value 80 must be entered
here.
Underdelivery is only checked when the operation is logged off.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.MENGEPROZ:UNTLI)
menge_pri_untli_r Reaction to underdelivery char(1) Reaction to underdelivery
empty: Tolerance is not checked
X: Error which is created if the tolerance quantity defined as percentage in the above-mentioned field Underdelivery is not
reached. This validation check may not be overridden by a mandatory posting.
W: Warning if tolerance quantity is exceeded or not reached. This validation check may be overridden by a mandatory posting
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:UNTLIR)
mengenpruefung Quantity check char(4) Quantity check
[1,1]
Activate 100 % quantity check (J/N)
If this option is enabled, the entire target quantity of the operation must be declared as yield or (for example) as scrap, i.e. the
total quantity must be at least equal to the target quantity.
For this reason, an operation may only be logged off if the total target quantity has been confirmed/uploaded, i.e. the total
quantity was either posted as yield or scrap.
[2,2]
Consider additionally in case of inspections: Scrap (J/N)
When under/overdelivery or quantity is checked, scrap must also be included.
[3,3]
Consider additionally in case of inspections: Rework quantity (J/N)
When under/overdelivery or quantity is checked, rework quantity must also be included.
[4,4]

When under/overdelivery or quantity is checked, open quantity must also be included.

nacharbeits_ag Rework OP char(1) Rework operation
Currently, this field is only used as a comment and cannot be edited.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:NCHANR)
nicht_unterbr Cannot be interrupted char(1) Cannot be interrupted
If this option is checked, the detailed planning must plan the operation so that it is not interrupted by a time without shift (e.g.
shift breaks).
N: Not considered, i.e. in the planning an operation can be "interrupted" by times without shift.
W: In the planning, an operation can be "interrupted" by times without shift A warning is issued, however.
J: No scheduling for manual/automatic detailed scheduling. The "J" flag is currently not used as there might be the risk for the
automatic detailed scheduling that an OP will never be scheduled.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:NAUNPLAN)
opt_erfassung Miscellaneous flags regarding capturing char(10) Miscellaneous flags regarding capturing

Check status of preceding OP
Check whether or when the current OP may be logged on:

be logged on"

planen Planning char(1) This setting specifies whether and how operations are relevant for detailed scheduling.
The following settings are available
N: No scheduling (no transfer to planning component)
T: Scheduling only
F: Scheduling and detailed planning. The operation is relevant for detailed planning. Therefore, this operation is not only
included in the scheduling but also in the automatic and/or interactive planning.
Scheduling means
J the operation is scheduled , i.e. lead time is determined on the basis of process times and dates are set accordingly.
Competitive situations are not taken into account for (lead time) scheduling.
N the operation is not scheduled. The scheduled end date of the predecessor OP and the scheduled start date of the
subsequent OP are used as start date and end date. Lead time is not taken into account.
-> planning only, to avoid differentiation
Detailed scheduling means
J The operation is dispatched to a workplace when it comes to the automatic dispatching (detailed scheduling). In this context,
capacity and reservation situation of the workplace are taken into account, which might lead to that fact that dispachting at the
planned date is impossible from lead time scheduling.
N With the automatic dispatching (detailed scheduling) the operation is dispatched without checking the capacity of the
workplace
-> planning only, to avoid differentiation
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:PLAN)
pp_caq_ab Log OP off with still unsettled inspections char(1) Log OP off with still unsettled inspections
J: If the operation is logged off or interrupted, no plausibility check is performed to find out if an inspection is still pending.
N: If the operation is logged off or interrupted, it is checked if an inspection is still pending. If this is the case, the logoff or
interruption of the operation is refused and a corresponding note is sent.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:PPCAQAB)
pp_caq_m_ag_ab Log main OP off with still unsettled char(1) Log main OP off with still unsettled inspections
inspections
This parameter is only available with main operations that include linked operations.
J: If the operation is logged off or interrupted, it is checked for all linked operations if an inspection is still pending. If this is the
case, the logoff of the main operation is refused and a corresponding note is sent.
N: If the main operation is interrupted, no plausibility check is performed to find out if an inspection is still pending for the linked
operations.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:PPQMMAGAB)
pp_caq_m_ag_un Interrupt main OP with still unsettled char(1) Interrupt main OP with still unsettled inspections
inspections
This parameter is only available with main operations that include linked operations.
J: If the main operation is interrupted, the system checks for all linked operations whether or not inspections are still pending. If
this is the case, the interruption of the main operation is refused and a corresponding note is sent.
N: If the main operation is interrupted, no plausibility check is performed to find out if an inspection is still pending for the linked
operations.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:PPQMMAGUN)
pruefmerkmal Inspection characteristic expected char(1) Inspection characteristic expected
This indicator describes whether or not inspection characteristics are to be recorded for this operation and is respectively
displayed for the operation at the shop floor terminal
X: Yes, display only
N: No, an inspection is not required; no inspection characteristic is expected
J: Yes, with processing --> Currently not used
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:PMERKM)

seriennr_pflicht Serial number obligation char(1) If this option is checked, postings must be made by serial number as of this operation.
J: Yes, irrespective of whether serial numbers were transferred or not.
N: No, even if serial numbers were transferred.
E: Manual entry of serial number
G: Automatic generation of serial number
S: Generation of serial numbers using number ranges
A: Collection of serial numbers
U: Merge serial numbers
Please note: This information is redundantly stored in the operation. Only the information stored in the operation is relevant for
processing.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:SNR)
sollm_abgl Target quantity update char(1) Use this option to activate a comparison of the target quantity when an operation is logged off (="FinishOP" posting).
J: The Target quantity update is enabled for this operation, i.e. when an operation is logged off, the posted yield is transferred
to the subsequent operations as target quantity. This is even valid for a combination of one or several parallel sequences (->
order network) as well as info operations (see configuration ID previously ERFASSBAR)
The target quantity continues to be updated, even for partial confirmations/uploads of OPs or OP interruptions, if the target
quantity of the current operation is exceeded as a result (is only performed online, not during recalculation!).
When updating the target quantity to a split operation, the quantity is equally distributed in integer values, which might lead to
a split OP getting a higher or lower target quantity. In this context, please also consider the underdelivery quantity/overdelivery
quantity (recalculate).
N: Target quantity update is disabled for this operation. If an operation is finished, the target quantity of other operations is not
changed.
Please note: this flag is transferred to AUFTRAGS_BESTAND.SOLLMENGENFORTS (redundant); but cannot be displayed or
changed there.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:SMENGEABGL)
splitten May be split char(4) May be split
V: This operation may be split.
If the number of splits has already been transferred via the interface, then the split is performed directly in the interface.
N: The operation may not be split.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:SPLIT)
synchronisierung Synchronization with successor OP char(1) Synchronization with successor OP
J: The start date of the successor OP is synchronized with the finish date of the operation. The period between these two
times may not exceed the maximum synchronization time stored in the operation. When planning changes are made, the
relationship between the two operations remains the same or must remain the same, which might restrict the planning options.
If overlapping is planned it has to be considered respectively.
Through the functions it is also possible to define sequences of several operations for synchronization.
It has to be taken into account even for order sequences and for order networks
N: Synchronization is not planned, i.e. an operation can be planned an entire shift or only one hour after the end of the
preceding operation. Of course, also in this case you cannot plan a successor before this operation.
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:AGNSYNC)
ueberlappung Overlapping char(1) Overlapping
The following types of overlapping are supported
N: No overlapping
S: Target overlapping. Here, scheduling and planning assumes an overlapping. This does not mean, however, that it must be
used.
K: Optional overlapping. Here, overlapping can be used during the reduction process. In this case, when there are enough
buffers and/or no scheduling bottleneck, there is no overlapping.
M: Mandatory overlapping. In this case, overlapping is enforced by planning, i.e. the two predecessor OPs are synchronized
as specified. Overlapping may either by specified by a send-ahead quantity or lead time. Both parameters describe the offset
of the predecessor to its successor. Lead time may also be negative, i.e. the successor starts with seupt prior to the
predecessor. Currently not used
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:UEBLAP)
uebli_untli_menge Check quantites for under-/overdelivery char(3) Please also include the following quantity accounts in addition to yield when overdelivery or underdelivery are checked
[1,1] scrap (J/N)
[2,2] rework quantity (J/N)
[3,3] problem quantity (J/N)
(PDM field ID: VACODE.OPT:UEBLIUNTLI)

| prod_kenn | Production Characteristic | char(2) | "X" - prepared |     |
| --------- | ------------------------- | ------- | -------------- | --- |
The OP is blocked
"V" - prepared
"Release indicator" for , BEFORE the OP is processed for the first time
"Y" - Inactive
The OP is in an alternative sequence and can only be logged on when the sequence is activated and thus the production
indicator is set to "V"
"L" - OP: running/ AU: in process
is automatically set when the OP is logged on
"U" - interrupted
is automatically set when the OP is unterrupted
"F" - autom. interrupted
is set by the server when the OP is supposed to be interrupted automatically at the change of shifts wir
"E" - finished
is automatically set when the OP is finished
"S" - None
other status, i.e. all other statuses: no automatic; means: OP has not yet been processed S
"A" - archived
The OP has been finished and archived according to a_auftrags_bestand, etc.
"D" - deleted
The OP has been deleted.

summarized in the backlog.

SPL -> split

Particularities in
TPL
(PDM field ID: ANR.ATYP)
| (C) MPDV |     |     | Datum: 10.02.2021 | 105 |

abmeldopt Logoff options char(10) This field is only kept for internal processing at the OP, the processing code is maintained and is taken over automatically!
[1,1]: This option controls which types of logging off are allowed.
"U" In case of a manual logoff, the OP is not finished but merely interrupted.
"B" OP only logoff when active processing-code
!= "U" OP logof (STD)
[2,2] Automatic transmission of an interruption to the preceding OPs till the next beginning of a milestone
""/"N" No automatic transmission (standard)
"J/U" In case of an INTERRUPTION, interrupt the preceding OPs
[3,3]: If this indicator is set the target quantity is automatically checked at each quantity posting and the OP is automatically
finished if the target quantity is reached. It takes the yield quantity into account and is analyzed in connection with the following
indicators.
""/"N" it is not automatically finished when the target quantity is reached (standard)
"J" it is automatically finished when the target quantity is reached
"U" it is automatically interrupted when the target quantity is reached
"F" it is automatically finished when the target quantity is reached und log subsequent OP on with the same article
number
"K" it is automatically finished when the target quantity is reached und log subsequent OP on with the same
campaigning number
The OP is not finished but interrupted if the OP, which lies before this OP in the OP sequence, with the indicator target
quantity update="J" is not finished
[4,4] - see [3,3] or [7,7] + SCRAP = "J"
[5,5] - see [3,3] or [7,7] + REWORK= "J"
[6,6] - see [3,3] or [7,7] + PROBLEM QUANTITY= "J"
[7,7] The preceding OPs are automatically finished till the next beginning of a milestone (see indicator [8,8])
""/"N" No automatism
"J" preceding OPs are finished - only running OPs with the indicator "external processing"
"j" preceding OPs are finished - all running OPs, too
"M" preceding Ops are finished and filled up to the respective target quantity, in order to determine the remaining
quantity
is referred to depending on [4,6] yield and also other quantities.
"m" preceding OPs are finished with an automatic posting of the residual quantity - all running OPs, too
[8,8] Beginning of milestone
in connection with [7,7]
(PDM field ID: ANR.OPT:xx)
abruest_zeit Teardown time integer Teardown time planned by PPS (teardown time)
(PDM field ID: ANR.ABRZ)
abruest_zeit_expr Formula char(6) If RUEST_ZEIT_MOD is set to "F": Reference to formula
(PDM field ID: ANR.ABRZ:EXPR)
abruest_zeit_mod Calculation mode char(1) Calculated
F = via formula
M = manually (by the user)
(PDM field ID: ANR.ABRZ:MOD)
afo_lfd_nr Operation Position integer Consecutive numbering of the OPs of an order, 1..X
The shop floor scheduling module requires them and they must not be changed. If an OP is
deleted or inserted both values have to be redetermined for each OP of the order.
ATTENTION: consecutive number according to the sorting of the OP number; does not represent the sequency of the order
(PDM field ID: AGPOS)

Processing code (= SAP control key; 4-digit in SAP)
(Does the processing code change when reassigning to another machine (group)?)
(PDM field ID: ANR.VERARBCODE)
verarb_code_mod Processing code mode integer It is recorded here which values in the order backlog and that are alos in the processing code have been changed manually.
0 - no modification
<> 0 - modified
The logging is carried out "byte by byte":
1 overdelivery/underdelivery incl. reaction
2 external/internal processing
3 can be recorded
4 can be logged on simultaneously
5 can be split
6 serial number requirement
7 batch management requirement
8 sequencing list
The indicator is also set if the respective value is transferred directly at the PPS interface.

vorlaufzeit Lead time integer An overlap can either be specified by a send-ahead quantity or by a lead time. Both parameters describe the offset of the

Attention: this is also to be taken into account in case of order networks.

(PDM field ID: ANR.WEIGMENGE)
wpkz Deletion flag char(1) Deletion flag

2.28. bm_konten

| Table name: bm_konten |     | Product: BDE |     |     |
| --------------------- | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: Resource performance accounts Description: Resource performance accounts (RPA) consist of exactly 12 time accounts, which are processed by the
system in relation operation, workplace/machine and resource (e.g. tool). They are used for classified time recording,
as is customary in REFA, and can be used in various reports and evaluations. Depending on the current status of the
workplace/machine, the time is charged to the resource performance account that was defined for this particular
status during system configuration.
# Special remarks
The resource performance accounts are predefined by MPDV and the customer may only change them after having
contacted MPDV and before any data acquisition is done.
The following restrictions are applicable:
- Productive times ("production") are always posted to RPA 11.
- Neutral times (e.g. no-shift times like weekends) are always posted to RPA 12.
# Key
nummer
# Connections to other tables
Each machine status in database tabel stoer_tabelle - (exept status 20000 and 30000 - must be assigned to a RPA:
  stoer_tabelle.bmk = bm_konten.kuerzel
RPA number are stored in the workplace-related result record:
  ereignis.bmktonr = bm_konten.nummer

It is indicated here which kind of system message is concerned:
1: log records for scrap without reason
2: log records for a target/actual deviation of > +- 5%
3: Entries in the machine order when the order/OP is not available or running anymore
4: Entries in intrasystem memory table for relogons of people when order/OP is not available or running anymore or
when the person is not available anymore
5: Personnel log records that are not approved
6: Overhead cost log records that are not approved
7: Operation-related result record for which there are no orders/OPs
8: the workplace is defined as ADE and MDE machine
10: the last OP of the order has already been finished although at least one preceding OP has not yet been finished
K: ANP-000580: automatic logoff by PZE (hy_ups)
According to the kind of message, not all data fields are allocated
(PDM field ID: MSTPRO.TYP)

3.19. caq_dokus

| Table name: caq_dokus      |     | Product: CAQ              |     |     |
| -------------------------- | --- | ------------------------- | --- | --- |
| Archive table: a_caq_dokus |     | Reload table: r_caq_dokus |     |     |
| Designation: Documents     |     | Description: Objective:   |     |     |
The spreadsheet manages the document entries. These document entries may include links to files or URLs.
Alternatively, multiline texts can be filed here. The doku_typ field decides on the type of the document entry. If texts
with more than 250 characters are to be filed they are distributed to the fields text_1 to text_10 in character strings of
250 characters each. Word-wraps are masked via the character string ~"~ (ASCII: 126, 33, 126).
| Column name | Column designation | Type     | Description |     |
| ----------- | ------------------ | -------- | ----------- | --- |
| anlage      | Created by         | char(50) |             |     |
anlage_date Date when the entry was created date Date when the entry was created
anlage_time Time when the entry was created. integer Time when the entry was created.
| bearb      | Last editor       | char(50) | Last editor                         |     |
| ---------- | ----------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------- | --- |
| bearb_date | Last editing day  | date     | Last editing day                    |     |
| bearb_time | Last editing time | integer  | Last editing time                   |     |
| bereich    | Area              | char(10) | Valid area of the CAQ_BEREICH table |     |
(PDM field ID: CDOKUM.BER,CPPLDOK.BER)
| doklist_nr | SERIAL of the entry | serial    |                      |     |
| ---------- | ------------------- | --------- | -------------------- | --- |
| doku_bez   | Designation         | char(250) | Document designation |     |
(PDM field ID: CDOKUM.DOKBEZ,CMMDOK.DOKBEZ,...DOKBEZ)
doku_nr Consecutive number integer Consecutive number which determines the document entry in the list of assigned documents
(PDM field ID: CDOKUM.DOKNR,CMMDOK.DOKNR,CPPLDOK.DOKNR)
doku_typ Type of the entry char(50) 'TEXT' - Text document (fields text_1 ... text_10 assigned)
'DATEI' - Reference to a file (field doku_url assigned)
'URL' - reference to an URL (field doku_url assigned)
(PDM field ID: CDOKUM.DOKTYP,CMMDOK.DOKTYP,...DOKTYP)
doku_url URL of a document char(250) ./<Dateiname/-pfad> - Reference to a file within the host computer directory
(PDM field ID: CDOKUM.DOKURL,CMMDOK.DOKURL,...DOKURL)
key_1 Identifier 1 integer If REC_REF = "MEK"  to be equated with the characteristics number
If REC_REF = "PPL"  to be equated with the inspection plan number
If REC_REF = "PAN", "PAU"  to be equated with the parameter CDOKUM.PANNR (inspection requirement number)
If REC_REF = "RKK", "RKD"  to be equated with the parameter CDOKUM.REKNR (complaints number)
If REC_REF = "PMK"  to be equated with the parameter CDOKUM.PMNR (gage number)
If REC_REF = "CPL"  to be equated with the parameter CDOKUM.CPLNR (control plan number)
(PDM field ID: CDOKUM.KEY:1,CMMDOK.LFDNR,CPPLDOK.PPLNR)

key_1 Identifier 1 integer If REC_REF = "MEK" to be equated with the characteristic number

key_2 Identifier 2 integer If REC_REF = "PPL"  to be equated with the OP number
If REC_REF = "PAU"  to be equated with the inspection order number
If REC_REF = "RKD"  to be equated with the complaints detail number
If REC_REF = "PMK"  to be equated with the failure analysis tree ID
key_3 Identifier 3 integer If REC_REF = "PAU"  to be equated with the operation number
If REC_REF = "RKD"  to be equated with the failure analysis tree ID

rec_ref Data reference char(20) 'MEK' = Characteristics catalog
'PAN' = Document from inspection requirement
'PAU' = Document from inspection order or subordinate structure (characteristic, measured value)
'PPL' = Document from inspection plan or subordinate structure (characteristic)
'RKK' = Document from complaints header
'RKD' = Document from complaints detail or subordinate structure (failure analysis)
'PMK' = Document from gage header or subordinate structure (failure analysis)
'CPL' = Production control plan (Control Plan)
rec_type Input type char(50) Empty = Global structures (characteristics catalog)
'WEP' = Goods receipt inspection
'FEP' = In-production inspection
'WAP' = Goods issue inspection
'EMU' = Initial sample inspection
'PMV' = Gage management
'REK' = Complaints management
'CPL' = Production control plan (Control Plan)

4.3. hls_setup
Table name: hls_setup Product: HLS
Designation: Setup für HLS
Column name Column designation Type Description
bearb char(10) Last editor
bearb_date date Last editing day
bearb_time integer Last editing time
default_term_richt Default scheduling direction char(1) Default scheduling direction (V/R)
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.DEFTERMR)
feinplan_horizont Detailed scheduling horizon smallint Detailed scheduling horizon
When it comes to the automatic planning it is planned within this horizon.
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.PLANHORIZ)
fix_horizont Planning time fence smallint Planning time fence
When it comes to the automatic planning the scheduled OPs are fixed within this horizon
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.FIXHORIZ)
fixpunkt_term Checkpoint scheduling char(1) If, despite reduction, the earliest end time (EET) of an operation is greater than the finish date of the production order (forward
scheduling) or if the latest start time (LST) lies before the start date of the production order (backward scheduling) the finish
date of the production order cannot be kept. In this case, this flag decides whether the
"S" =Start or
"E" = End
of the order are adhered to.
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.FIXPKTTERM)
hls_kennz char(10) [1,1] Scheduling for OPs that are firmly planned (planning component 1.11)
V = add OPs to planned OPs -> forward scheduling is of higher priority
R = add OPs to planned OPs -> backward scheduling is of higher priority
J = add OPs to planned OPs -> backward scheduling in case of forward scheduling, forward scheduling in case of backward
scheduling
N/empty = no consideration
[2,2] Taking queue time into account when scheduling
V = shift model of preceding OP is used to calculate the queue time
N = shift model of succeeding OP is used to calculate the queue time
G = Gregorian calendar is used to calculate the queue time
[3,3] Read Resource object list
NULL = read Resource object list
J = read Resource object list
N = not read Resource object list
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.HLSKENNZ)
linksverschiebung Displacement to the left char(1) Depending on this flag, operations whose scheduled start lies within the planning horizon are treated differently regarding the
dispatching start date when it comes to the automatic planning. If the indicator is set a "shift to the left" is made. The
dispatching start date is set to "now" + planning lead time. This means: it is attempted to dispatch the operation before the
scheduled start date. If the indicator is not set the scheduled start date is used as dispatching start date.
The flag is only evaluated for the first operation of an order that can be planned
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.OPT:LV)
plan_vorlauf Planning lead time integer Planning lead time in sec. Automatic planning starts at Now + planning lead time (e.g. 3h)
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.PLANVL)
prio_nicht_berueck priority char(4) Orders whose priority is less than the priority defined here are not considered when it comes to the automatic, server-based
planning. If this field remains empty all orders (independent of their priority) are taken into account.
Attention: This refers to the priority defined in the order header not to the priority of the operations
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.PRIONBER)
simul_horizont Simulation horizon smallint Beyond the dispatching horizon operations are simulated taking the actual capacity into account and the single results are
written in the respective fields for the dates. This simulation takes place in the defined simulation horizon
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.SIMHORIZ)
skyline_horizont smallint Currently not used
streubreite smallint Currently not used
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 326

| --------------- | -------------------------------------- | --------- | --- | --- |
BAPI string that is retrieved when the escalation is closed (solved). The BAPI string may contain wildcards such as
%AKRONYM% , which are replaced by the memorized values of the original dialog data. The wildcard
"%ESKMSG.BEMGR%" contains the value from esk_event_msg.end_res, the wildcard "%ESKMSG.BEM%" contains the
corresponding solution text from esk_event_msg.end_remark.
cycl_day Cycle in days integer Number of days between 2 cycles (default value for the configuration)
cycl_secs Cycle in seconds integer Seconds between 2 checking processes (default value for the configuration)
cyclic Event to be monitored cyclically char(1) J / N - cyclic monitoring Yes/No
By means of this indicator, events, which have to be monitored, are marked as they cannot actively trigger an escalation.
(J/N). If an event is defined as "monitored cyclically" the cyclic monitoring can be defined in the 2 following fields.
event_cat Category char(1) A=application-related (e.g.: ZKS: Entry open)
T=technical  (e.g. interface SAP: no connection, (e.g. network: client offline, ZKS: sabotage)
There is a division in categories in order to simplify the evaluation of the events and configurations und to provide the user a
better overview.
event_class Produkt classification char(10) Product classification (e.g. PZE / PDV / S YS)
Further division below the category. It can be classified according to the product, for example, in order to enable a selection of
PZE events. Thus, there is the classification in e.g. PZE, PDV, TERM, etc...
event_id Event ID char(40) Each event is determined by a unique ID. When starting the escalation manager, the EVENT_ID is absolutely necessary to
identify the respective escalation.
event_name Description of the escalation char(100) Description of the escalation
licensekeys License check char(80) If allocated, the event can only be used if one of the licenses is available. Several licenses are separated by a blank character.

5.8. esk_function
Table name: esk_function Product: KERNEL
Designation: Function groups
Column name Column designation Type Description
functiondesc Description of the function char(40) Description of the function (e.g. person in charge of the terminal)
Designation of the group to which the respective person belongs
(PDM field ID: ESKFKT.ESKFKT)
opt Options char(10) ESKFKT.OPT:1
opt[1,1]
Check whether logged on to the console in case it should be informed via the console; i.e. if = J the message is only sent if the
user is logged on.
(Therefore, it is important to state the console, which is normally operated by the user ("regular console"), in the HR master in
order that a message can be sent even if the user is not logged on.
ESKFKT.OPT:2
opt[2,2]
Check if attendant according to PZE
ESKFKT.OPT:3
opt[3,3]
Check whether person is not on vacation
- for future use -
(PDM field ID: ESKFKT.OPT:x)
person_nr Personnel number char(10) Reference to the HR master
A connection to the employees and their data (e-mail, sms, pager, client number) is established via the personnel number.
(PDM field ID: ESKFKT.PNR)
prio Notification priorirty of the person integer The priority determines the sequence of the notification. Thus, the person(s) with highest priority (1) are infomed at first. If
these employees are not attendant or logged on the employee(s) with the next highest priority (2) are informed. By means of
these priorities it is possible to determine representatives that are informed if the leading person in charge is not attendant.
Thus, it is guaranteed that important messages are even processed if the respective person is absent (unscheduled).
(PDM field ID: ESKFKT.PRIO)
verweis DB reference serial Database reference

5.18. hybuch

| Table name: hybuch             |     | Product: KERNEL         |     |     |
| ------------------------------ | --- | ----------------------- | --- | --- |
| Designation: Posting of events |     | Description: Objective: |     |     |
Basic data for the generation of log records (ADE/MDE) for batches (replaces masch_charge) are kept in this table.
Batches:
All batches assigned to an order and a machine are filed in this table. In this table the respective entry only exists as
long as the batch is logged on. The data fields are allocated as given within the batch status; however, they contain the
numbers of pieces and times since the current logon.
Description:
The table is described in the documentation of ADE and MDE tables.

| anmeld_zeit |                    | integer  | Logon time                     |     |
| artikel     |                    | char(40) | Article for the OP or material |     |
Only assigned in case of key_type "C" (Batch)

Recorded RPA values are transferred from dialog to hybuch -> auftrag_status -> ade_protokoll and  event_xxx.
The input type at the activity code defines how this is done:

· "XU"/"XE" calculated according to formula

param_01 integer Remaining duration in seconds in case of ratio BMK posting at the processing center or in case of parallel OPs at the machine
Field is set to 0 at the change of shifts
param_02 integer Reserved/free for customer-specific data
param_03 decimal(18,6) MPL: Input quantity for input batches
Reserved/free for customer-specific data
param_04 integer Remaining labor time in seconds when posting the labor utilization
Field is set to 0 at the change of shifts
param_05 integer MPLRF: number of individual batches in case of collective batch (output batches when cutting rolls)
total number of generated output batches in case of input batch (mother roll)
param_str1 char(40) Reserved/free for customer-specific data
param_str2 Material char(40) MPL: Article number
param_str3 BOM item char(10) -MPL: in case of an input batch the bill of material item (BOM item) is concerned
param_str4 char(10) MPL: [1,1] = the material indicator for input batches (e.g. "T" for carrier material)
HYD-AEV: different indicators for logons of staff (key_type = 'P')
[1,1] : Enable quantity posting for person J/N
[2,2] : Enable continuous posting for person J/N
[3,3] : Enable counting as actual person for person J/N
pers_dauer integer Labor utilization compared with the shift calendar. This one is proportionate if the employee has logged on several times
By default the duration is compared with the shift calendar of the machine - if setup.p_pers_zeiten = "J" is active
it is compared with the person's personal shift model (personalstamm.stamm_j_mod)
Breaks within the shift calendar are not posted to the labor utilization
By default all RPAs are posted to the labor utilization - if setup.pdauer_bmk_verb[1,1] = J is set only statuses with the
configured RPAs are posted
to the labor utlization
By means of this, a break that is logged on (status with RPA 12), for example, can be hidden in the labor utilization.
(PDM field ID: EGR:PDAUER)

einheit_expr Formula char(6) Alternative to NENNER,ZAEHLER,EXPONENT,OFFSET:
It is the formula within the "quantity conversion" context
--> Reference to table of formulas
When it comes to unit conversion the value to be converted is defined within variable "X" (e.g. X+30/100).

(PDM field ID: EINHUMR.EXP)

| ------ | ----------- | ------- | -------------------------- | --- |

offset Additive constant float Additive constant (is required for the conversion of temperatures) (default 0).
(PDM field ID: EINHUMR.OFFSET)
op_code Operation code char(10) Operation code, may also be empty
for future use:
An "operation code" may be defined for the OP. If this code is indicated it can be referenced to this unit conversion table.
Example: 2 OPs; both are converted from LFM to KG but they have different density. Within the OP_CODE there is
"Varnishing" and "Coating". Now there are two entries in this table referring to different formulas. The formula itself includes
the density.
Please note: In case the density is written in a user field of the OP, then 1 formula is sufficient, i.e. no OP_CODE is required.
However, in this case the formula must be 100% identical and density must always be indicated in the same user field.

TEXT: Continuous text + "\n" + "\t"
Thus, text formatted in RTF or HTML could also be filed in future.
(PDM field ID: INFO.FMT)
key Staff badge no. char(40) ADE: order number (complete)
PZE : badge number for which the information is supposed to be displayed
Complete ident:
A*: Order or order/OP number (AUFTRAGS_NR)
P*: Personnel number
XMNR*: Machine number
(PDM field ID: INFO.KEY)
kurztext char(20) New field:
AN: Short ext of the note (is used as tab caption)
Otherwise: can be used freely
(PDM field ID: INFO.BEZ)
subkey1 Entry number integer ADE: Entry number (e.g. note number) starting with 0
PZE: Relevant for TYP PK (customer-specific info) only; otherwise empty:
2: Annual information from SAP
3: ZGRDINF
4: PERSINF
ATTENTION: Type change!!!!
Specific assignment
ATTENTION: the AGNR (OP No.) is not entered anymore in A*
AN: Index of the note; the index of the tab results from this; starting with 0
(PDM field ID: INFO.SUBKEY:1)
subkey2 integer ADE: Page number 1..n
PZE: Internal administration in SAP sub system. Otherwise not relevant for PZE.
Otherwise: Page number 1..n ("top down")
(PDM field ID: INFO.SUBKEY:2)
typ char(10) First character "A" for ADE.
"AI" : additional order information
"BI" : additional work plan information
"AX": additional data on the OP
previously (last scheduling of OP on machine/machine group)
"AD": additional data on the OP for label printing
"AU"/"AG": additional order data or OP data
First character "P" for PZE.
"PE" : Information entered manually
"PI" : Information generated via SAP sub system interface
"PM" : Mails generated via SAP sub system interface (IMAIL, ZMAIL)
"PN": Message generated via the escalation management
"PK" : Customer-specific information, other key in subkey1
First character "L" for Logbook.
"L_DETAIL": Detail entry
"L_MASTER": Master entry
(PDM field ID: INFO.TYP)
verweis serial ----
verweis_meldung integer For the type "PE" this field contains the reference of the message configuration from pze_info_par.
For the type "PN" this field contains the reference to the message of the event from the escalation management.
wochentag Weekday integer Day on which the message is displayed (7 = every day, 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday,
... , 6 = Saturday).
(PDM field ID: INFO.WTG)

Table name: setup Product: KERNEL
Designation: Basic settings Description: Entries specific to customers are made here. All programs have to evaluate these pieces of information in
order that the system can be used as flexibly as possible. MPDV sets the setup during the installation and it should not
be changed by the user as otherwise, errors might occur during processing. There is only one data record within the
table!
