anrgkm Posting to OP char(40) Waiting period processing machine
Determination of OP via
setup.mnrgk -> if empty overhead cost operation is "GKM<maschinennummer>" like in 6.5
in case of waiting period of machines
If the overhead cost operation of the machine is available it is updated with the computed times/duration
However, the overhead cost OP is not really logged on, thus there is no entry in hybuch and no status = "L"
No activitiets (neither times nor quantities) are charged on the waiting period OP
Like in 7.1 only a waiting period can be active = leading
If both waiting periods are activated the waiting period of machines is leading, i.e. the waiting period of personnel does not
carry out backing dating processes but onyl overhead cost records.
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 423

anrgkp Posting to OP char(40) Waiting period processing person
Determination of OP via
personalstamm.anrgk -> if empty -> setup.anrgk
If the person's waiting period operation is available it is updated with the computed times/duration
However, the waiting period OP is not really logged on, thus there is no entry in hybuch and no status = "L"
No activitiets (neither times nor quantities) are charged on the waiting period OP
Like in 7.1 only a waiting period can be active = leading
If both waiting periods are activated the waiting period of machines is leading, i.e. the waiting period of personnel does not
carry out backing dating processes but onyl waiting period records.

auto_monat_aw char(1) PZE: automatic evaluation of month/active by default

auto_pze HYD:PZE (in/out) controls ADE char(1) A/K/G/N PZE controls ADE
K:
Person is automatically logged on to the waiting period OP when clocking-in and automatically logged off when clocking-out.
The ADE waiting period processing is automatically activated.
A:
Clocking-out "interrupts" the order logged on but stores the orders and machines. These values are automatically "logged on"
again when clocking-in the next time. There is a waiting period posting between ADE logons. The ADE waiting period
processing is automatically activated. E
G:
A person is automatically logged off from the BDE system when clocking-out, if applicable (provided this is the last person) the
OP is also interrupted. However, there is no ADE waiting period processing.
N:
PZE does not affect ADE.
(PDM field ID: HYDRA.OPT:PZEAUTO)
barcode_nr_len HYD: Length AUNR + AGNR + 1 smallint Length of barcode of BDE order
is allocated with HYDRA.LEN:AUNR + HYDRA.LEN:AGNR + 1
(PDM field ID: (Composed of several acronyms))

melde_art Controlling the logon processes char(2) MA/MP: Control of the logon processes at the terminal
melde_art:
Terminals with logon type PA enable the multiple logon of orders to one machine/workplace.
This option is contrary to the application of a shop floor scheduling module.
The logon types MA and MP comply with the shop floor scheduling.
Differences: MA: order and person are logged on separately
MP: order and person are logged on together in one process
default = "MA"

5.65. vab_tab

| Table name: vab_tab               |     | Product: KERNEL     |     |     |
| --------------------------------- | --- | ------------------- | --- | --- |
| Designation: Responsibility areas |     | Description: # Note |     |     |
The contents of the table vab_tab are automatically generated by the system from the responsibility profiles and the
individual areas of responsibility. The content comes from the tables vab_authorization and vab_profil. The system
automatically resolves the responsibility profiles for the contents of table vab_tab.
Furthermore, the default responsibility area "--DEFAULT--" is automatically added for each user.
Always change the tables vab_authorization and vab_profile only via the respective API functions.
Never change the tables vab_authorization and vab_profil directly at database level, since the contents of table
vab_tab are not updated automatically if you access them directly from the database.

pnr_change.personalnummer = personen.personalnummer and pnr_change.datum_bis between personen.gueltig_von
and personen.gueltig_bis

| Archive table: a_ereignis |     | Reload table: r_ereignis |     |     |
Designation: Workplace-related result records Description: Each machine condition is entered in this table. The entries are made for machines with machine data
collection or, provided that it is activated, for the production data collection with activated log record generation for
the machine data collection (see setup.mde_gen). Then the log record generator for the machine data collection has to
be started cyclically.
Events are confirmed in case of changes of the machine condition and at the beginning/end of the shift. Thus, a
condition can never take longer than 86400 seconds.

7.5. masch_term_zuord
Table name: masch_term_zuord Product: MDE
Designation: Assignment of workplaces/machines to the terminal Description: Configuration of assigning workplaces/machines to terminals.
# Special remarks
A workplace must be assigned to a terminal in order to be able to use the MDE specific functions such as automatic
shift change, cyclical status update or data entry via interface. However, these functions are only available if the
terminal is configured as the so-called "MDE terminal". These functions are not active for terminals that are configured
as ADE terminals, not even if the workplaces are assigned to the terminal.
Assignment of a workplace to multiple terminals using SQL insert is not recommended and will not be supported by
MPDV.
# Key
terminal_nr, masch_nr
terminal_nr, anzeige_pos
# Connections to other tables
terminals.terminalnr = masch_term_zuord.terminal_nr
maschinen.masch_nr = masch_term_zuord.masch_nr
Column name Column designation Type Description
anzeige_pos Display position smallint Display position of the workplace/machine at the terminal
Please consider the maximum number of workplaces that should be assigned to a terminal.
(PDM field ID: MNRTNR.POS)
betriebsart Processing char(1) The following options are available:
A - ADE processing
M - MDE processing
(blank) - Processing according to operation mode definied in the terminal configuration (field terminals.mde_kz)
For a group workplace (maschinen.art=G), the flag must be set to "A" if this is to be assigned to an MDE terminal.
masch_nr Workplace/machine number char(20) Workplace/machine number that the terminal is assigned to
(PDM field ID: MNRTNR.MNR)
terminal_nr Terminal number smallint Terminal number that a workplace should be assigned to.
(PDM field ID: MNRTNR.TNR)

N: only one order can be logged on to the machine (default)
default = "N"
(PDM field ID: MNR.OPT:MULTIAG)
aus Scrap processing char(1) J/N/G : Processing of scrap
J = the automatic and manual scrap is deducted from the automatic yield (default)
N = the automatic and manual scrap is not deducted from the automatic yield
G = the automatic and manual scrap is not deducted from the automatic yield and manual scrap is additionally posted as
strokes (Hub=stroke+scrap/partitioning)
GUT-/AUS_xxxxx:
The pulses recorded via counters are collected as follows:
The counter of good parts provides a machine pulse, no numbers of pieces. Therefore, it has to be multiplied by partitioning.
Postings
Good parts += yield counter * partitioning (from order)
Scrap += Scrap counter
Good parts -= Scrap counter
In theory, the collection via the counter and manual input can be activated at the same time. However, practically, this is not
reasonable. In contrast to this, it is useful to record good parts via the counter and scrap manually. Customers use this
method.
default = "J"
(PDM field ID: MNR.OPT:AUS)
aus_dim Unit of scrap char(3) Dimension of the collected scrap; ST (default) MT, KG optional
default = "ST"
(PDM field ID: MNR.EGE:AUS)

default = "N"
(PDM field ID: MNR.OPT:AUSAUTO)
aus_manu Scrap, manual char(1) J/N, whether scrap can be entered manually or not (N = default)
default = "N"
(PDM field ID: MNR.OPT:AUSMANU)

plan_j_mod Planned year model smallint Planning year model; a planning shift model deviating from the BDE data collection model (system_j_mod), which is used in

planungsfunktion Planning function char(1) This indicator determines whether or in which planning function a workplace or a mchine is displayed.
P Planning in the graphical planning board of the shop floor scheduling module, i.e. the workplace is planned via the HLS and
thus it is visible there but not in the AVG (order sequencing).
Note: Whether a workplace is displayed in HLS also depends on other settings:
- assignment to a group that is marked as "capacity group"
- responsibility area authorization for this workplace
- user profile in the HLS
H = analogous to P. Furthermore, the workplace is also considered when it comes to the automatic (server-based) planning.
The automatic (server-based) planning is activated within the scope of the system customizing.
T = the workplace is only considered in case of the automatic, server-based planning. The workplace is not displayed in the
graphical planning board.
A = planning in the AVG module (order sequencing), i.e. the workplace is planned by means of AVG and thus it is visible there
but not in the HLS module.
N = No planning; the workplace is neither displayed in the AVG nor HLS module.

vorgabeliste char(1) By means of this option, it is defined which operations are displayed in the sequencing list at the terminal. The following
settings are possible:
S = Basic setting. The value is taken over from the option of the same name.
M = Pool of workplaces. The operations, which are planned for the workplace, are only displayed in the sequencing list at the
terminal.
G = Pool of workplaces and groups. Those OPs, which are either scheduled for the current workplace or for another workplace
of the group or which are still in the pool of groups, are displayed in the sequencing list at the terminal.
K = Pool of workplaces and categories. The operations, which are planned for workplaces of the category, are only displayed
in the sequencing list at the terminal.
H = Group control. Those OPs, which are either scheduled for the current workplace or for another workplace of the group, are
displayed in the sequencing list at the terminal.
wache_sign Number of single values for MDE-ZYK char(1) Number of single values for MDE-ZYK
default = "0"
(PDM field ID: MNR.MWANZ)
wache_takt Monitoring, cycle char(1) Z/B/K:
Z = Cycle monitoring
B = Operating signal
K = No monitoring
wache_takt:
Determines the kind of monitoring:
Z cycle time monitored = cycle time of the order * wache_zykl / 100
If this time is over without a counter pulse the terminal automatically switches to "STOEREINGABE" ("malfunction input").
It is not possible to assign the status "production" manually.
B If the operating signal is not set longer than (länger als) WACHEDAUER (monitoring time) the terminal switches
automatically to "STOEREINGABE" ("malfunction input").
It is not possible to assign the status "production" manually.
K The status production can be assigned manually (default).
default = "K"
default = "K"
(PDM field ID: MNR.UEBART)
wache_zykl % rate to determine actual cycle time smallint Percentage to determine the actual cycle time
Value < 100: cyle is reduced Value > 100: cycle is extended
default = 100
(PDM field ID: MNR.IZYABW)
wachedauer Min. disturbance time f. operat. signal smallint Minimum disturbance time for operating signal (seconds)
Minimum cycle time at cycle time monitoring (seconds)
default = 0
(PDM field ID: MNR.UEBDAUER)

7.8. maschinen_status

| Table name: maschinen_status |     | Product: MDE |     |     |
| ---------------------------- | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: Machine condition Description: The current statuses of the machine terminals are entered in this table. If a machine terminal is restarted
the machine status is read and taken as basis. Approximately every two to three minutes these conditions are
transferred from the terminals for each configured machine to the host computer. If the menu item "machine overview"
is selected in the production data collection client only thos machines, which have an entry in this table, are displayed
(provided that you have the cost center authorization fir these machines).
Objective:
This table is intended for the collection of machine-related variable data. The contents are set to 0 at each end of the
shift. If the log record generator for the machine data collection is available the table is edited via this program.

7.14. stoer_tabelle
Table name: stoer_tabelle Product: MDE
Designation: Machine/workplace conditions Description: Defintion of the different machine/workplace statuses that can occur.
# Special remarks
With creating a new workplace/maschine using the appropriate service two statuses 20000 ("NO SHIFT") and 30000
("NOT ASSIGNED") are automatically created. They must not be deleted.
# Key
masch_nr, stoernr
# Connections to other tables
maschinen.masch_nr = stoer_tabelle.masch_nr
stoertexte.stoertxt_nr = stoer_tabelle.stoertxt_nr
bm_konten.bmk = stoer_tabelle.bmk (outer join)
mz_stklasse.kuerzel = stoer_tabelle.klasse (outer join)
ade_grund_zuord.grund (art=A) = stoer_tabelle.aus_grund (outer join)
ade_grund_zuord.grund (art=A) = stoer_tabelle.aus_grund_psperre (outer join)
auftrags_bestand.auftrag_nr = stoer_tabelle.folge_auftrag_nr (outer join)
Column name Column designation Type Description
abbruchgrund char(1) Reserved for future use.
(PDM field ID: MST.OPT:ABBGRD)
auftragsmeldung Operation posting char(5) [1,1] : operation posting when the status is assigned manually
K/blank: No processing
U: Automatic interruption of all running OPs at the workplace and logoff all persons logged on the the workplace
A: Automatic interruption of all running OPs at the workplace and logoff all persons logged on the the workplace. Then logon of
the operation defined in field folge_auftrag_nr
[2,2] : not supported, leave blank
[3,3] : Take over active persons
J: Take over (log on) active persons to the following operation defined in field folge_auftrag_nr
N: No processing
(PDM field ID: MST.MELDOPT:1..5)
aus_grund Scrap reason integer Automatic scrap reason that is assigned to automatically recorded scrap during the actual status (production lock is not active)
(PDM field ID: MST.GR:AUSNRAUTO)
aus_grund_psperre Scrap reason during production lock integer Automatic scrap reason during production lock is active.
(PDM field ID: MST.GR:AUSNRPSPERRE)
automatic Automatically via digital input char(1) This option must be activated if a status assignment is made automatically via machine interface (CT-MSS, CT-UMPS, PCC).
J: Processing is activated. The number of the digital input through which a status occurrence is detected must be entered in
the field zuord_nr
N: No processing
(PDM field ID: MST.OPT:AUTO)
bearb char(10) Reserved for future use.
bearb_date date Reserved for future use.
bearb_time integer Reserved for future use.
blinkzeit integer Reserved for future use.
bmk Resource performance account char(3) Resource performance account (RPA/BMK) to which the status is assigned.

This value must exist in database table bm_konten
(PDM field ID: MST.BMKNR)
farbe integer Not supported. The color of a status is defined in the database table stoertexte.
folge_auftrag_nr Order number of follow-up operation char(40) This operation (Order number) is automatically logged on if auftragsmeldungen[1,1] = 'A'
(PDM field ID: MST.ANRN)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 522

klasse Status class char(3) Status class to which the status is assigned.
Reference to mz_stklasse.kuerzel
This value must exist in database table mz_stklasse
(PDM field ID: MST.STKL)
kosten_art integer Used for bonus calculations
default = 0
last_kst01 (multiple use) char(10) [1]-[3] : Reserved
[4] : Use of unplanned material
J - Use of unplanned material is allowed, i.e. batches that are not specified in the input material list at the operation can be
logged on as input material
N - Use of unplanned material is not allowed
[5]-[10] : Reserved
(PDM field ID: (Composed of several acronyms))
last_kst02 (multiple use) char(10) [1] : Machine-related and/or order-related standstill reason
M - machine-related -> status is only allowed if no OP is active
A - order-related -> status only allowed if at least one OP is active
X/empty - not machine-related and not order-related (no check)
[2]-[10] : Reserved
(PDM field ID: (Composed of several acronyms))
last_kst03 (multiple use) char(10) Reserved
(PDM field ID: (Composed of several acronyms))
last_kst04 (multiple use) char(10) Reserved
(PDM field ID: MST.SAPSTKL)
last_kst05 (multiple use) char(10) [1] : Activate production lock
J - Activate production lock when status is set by the terminal or PCC
N - Deactivate production lock when status is set by the terminal or PCC
[2-8] : Reserved
[9] : Transfer of the status of the line to the aggregates
J - Transfer of the status of the line to the aggregates (MDE-SFL only)
N - Do not transfer of the status of the line to the aggregates (MDE-SFL only)
[10] : Reserved
(PDM field ID: (Composed of several acronyms))
manuell Manually at terminal char(1) Plausibility check, if operator can assign this status manually
J : Operator can enter this status manually at the terminal.
N: Operator can enter this status manually at the terminal. Status will no longer be displayed in the status selection list at the
terminal.

masch_nr Workplace char(20) Workplace/Machine number to which the status is assigned (mandatory).

p_abmeld Log staff off char(1) Automatism to log of persons when status is set

N : persons stay logged on.
(PDM field ID: MST.OPT:PAB)
prod_kenn Control characteristic char(1) The following identifiers are available to control machine monitoring. Except for the "production" control indicator, all following
control indicators are only allowed for machines/workplaces of the type "individual workplace".
P: designates "production", to be defined exactly once per workplace
S: designates "all other status", a maximum of 9999 entries per workplace (type "individual workplace")
A: designates the "general disturbance", to be defined exacly once per machine (type "individual workplace")
Z: designates "short-term disturbance", to be defined max. once per machine (type "individual workplace")
H: designates the status as "hierarchy level" (type "individual workplace")
N: is used internally for "not assigned" at the terminal
O: no order: the terminal automatically sets this status when the last operation is interrupted/logged off, to be defined max.
once per machine (type "individual workplace")
(PDM field ID: MST.OPT:PKENN)
prog_stillstd_zeit Estimated downtime integer Once a status is set, an estimated downtime can be entered during manual status assignment. In the process, the downtime
defined in the master data is shown as a suggestion. During automatic status change, the downtime defined in the master data
is automatically set.
(PDM field ID: MST.PROGNDAUER)
psperre char(1) Reserved
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 523

N: deactivate/do not set machine lock
(PDM field ID: MST.OPT:MSPERRE)

7.15. stoertexte

| Table name: stoertexte |     | Product: MDE |     |     |
| ---------------------- | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: Workplace/machine status texts Description: Definition of all possible workplace/machine states (statuses). These status texts are then used in the
status assignment. The goal is to use standard status texts for all workplaces and machines.
# Special remarks
Important states that have always to be available:
 20000 NO SHIFT
 30000 NOT ASSIGNED
# Key
stoertxt_nr
# Connections to other tables
Each machine status must be assigned to a status text:
  stoer_tabelle.stoertxt_nr = stoertexte.stoertxt_nr
Status text number are stored in the workplace-related result record:
  ereignis.stoertxt_nr = stoertexte.stoertxt_nr

7.16. system_j_mod

| Table name: system_j_mod |     | Product: MDE |     |     |
| ------------------------ | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: BDE (PDC) year model Description: Definition of the year model for the production data collection. Each work day is assigned exactly to a day
type in the year model. Each machine can be assigned to exactly one year model.
# Special remarks
A year model has to be assigned to each workplace/machine as otherwise there will be no time recording.
A different year model can optionally be assigned to a workplace/machine for considering in the shopfloor planning
(HLS).
Only one year model may be defined as a factory calendar.
# Key
jahr, schicht_mod
# Connections to other tables
A year model is assgined to a machine:
  maschinen.schichtmod = system_j_mod.schicht_mod
  personen.stamm_j_mod = system_j_mod.schicht_mod (optional)
For scheduling purposes (HLS) the following connections are possible:
  maschinen.plan_j_mod = system_j_mod.schicht_mod
  hy_gruppen.schichtmod = system_j_mod.schicht_mod
| Column name | Column designation | Type     | Description                 |     |
| ----------- | ------------------ | -------- | --------------------------- | --- |

| bearb_date  | Last editing day   | date     |                             |     |
| bearb_time  | Last editing time  | integer  |                             |     |
| jahr        | Year               | smallint | Year in 4 digits, e.g. 2018 |     |
(PDM field ID: BDEJMOD.JAHR)

| --------- | ----------- | -------- | ----------------------------- | --- |
(PDM field ID: BDEJMOD.BEZ)
modell Day model structure char(1464) For each day in the year (max, 366 days) 4 characters are provided for a day model: 4 * 366 = 1464 characters
When considering days off (no shifts) during configuration then blanks are stored at the corresponding day position.
(PDM field ID: BDEJMOD.MODELL)
| schicht_mod | Year model | smallint | Number of the year model |     |
| ----------- | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------ | --- |
(PDM field ID: BDEJMOD.BDEJMOD)
werkskalender Factory calendar char(1) A comprehensive factory calendar is used in the shopfloor scheduling (HLS). The factory calender is used, for example, to
determine the horizons (e.g. dispatching horizon).
J = factory calendar
N or blank = not a factory calendar

7.17. system_t_mod
Table name: system_t_mod Product: MDE
Designation: BDE (PDC) day model Description: The planned working times and break times for up to four shifts for each day are defined in a day model.
# Special remarks
Day types must first be defined before the shift plan can be created for each work day.
For technical reasons, a shift may not start or end at 12:00 am (midnight).
Only the last shift of a day model may include a day change (e.g. 10.00 pm - 6.00 am)!
# Key
tag_nr
# Connections to other tables
You assign BDE day models to BDE year models. Due to the way of saving the day model in a year model a SQL join is
not possible. Day model determination of the n-th day of a year (pseudocode):
position = (n-1) * 4
system_t_mod.tag_nr = substring(system_j_mod.modell, position, 4)

s2_schichtart Shift indicator shift 2 char(1) Shift indicator
Determination of a shift indicator that is independent of the previous shift number (CHAR, similar to PZE: early, late, night)
à In all reports/analyses (ADE and MDE) it is no longer evaluated according to the shift number but to the shift type. The
previouse shift number (1,2,3,4) is only used for internal purposes and does not influence the reports/analyses, i.e. the
analyses/reports have to be made in accordance with this indicator.
à Additional field everywhere where the (current, previous) shift number is saved as well (ade_protokoll, etc.)
à Level 1: allow only numerical values; thus the effort when converting the reports/analyses (e.g. MDE) is reduced at first.

If no appropriate input batch is available the expiry date is calculated according to the individual settings.
New option "S" = "expiry date from shift date" (KRN 11.10.04)

N =  from current point in time

S = from shift date>= 7.2.1.

9.19. mlst_hy

| Table name: mlst_hy      |     | Product: MPL            |     |     |
| ------------------------ | --- | ----------------------- | --- | --- |
| Archive table: a_mlst_hy |     | Reload table: r_mlst_hy |     |     |
Designation: Material list Description: If required, component lists/bill of materials of the operation are filed in this table. All input materials
intended for an order/OP are defined here.
| Column name   | Column designation | Type    | Description    |     |
| ------------- | ------------------ | ------- | -------------- | --- |
| anzahl_gesamt | Total entries.     | integer | Total entries. |     |
The anzahl_gesamt field must not be mistaken for the IST_MENGE. In ist_menge the total quantity required for the order is
entered and in anzahl_gesamt the frequency of the transferred bill of material items is allocated internally. Which means if
there is an entry of a resource with the required quantity  = 4 then in anzahl_gesamt = 1 and in ist_menge = 4 (ST).
-> Number of added items from bill of material
 = anzahl_gesamt - anzahl_von_pps
1 : Default value
anzahl_von_pps integer Entries coming from the PPS system. The anzahl_von_pps field is the frequency of positions directly coming from PPS.
O: not transferred by PPS system
artikel material number char(40) For materials: material number
For documents: optional, but should be filled so that something is displayed in the list at the console or terminal (can be the
name or file name)
(PDM field ID: MATLIST.ATK)

10.17. pdv_event_cfg

| Table name: pdv_event_cfg |     | Product: PDV |     |     |
| ------------------------- | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: PDV Event Configuration Description: This table can be used to configure any possible PDV relevant events that a maschine can communicate
(for example a line break down).
* Notes
Configured PDV Events can be assigned by using a logical channel to get captured from a machine. Appeared events
also can set a digital output for use of a alert notification.
* Keys
(event)
* logical connection to other tables
pdv_event_prot stores appeared/captured PDV Events (pepr.event = pec.event where pepr.type = 'E')
pdv_logic_chan can be used to assign a physical channel number (pec.event = plc.fkey, where plc.type = 'E')
| Column name | Column designation | Type | Description |     |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ---- | ----------- | --- |
alert Alert Mark char(1) Mark if specified PDV Event should cause an alert.
Possible values are: 'Y' or 'N' (N is default)
Y will cause alert
N (or everything else) will not cause an alert
(PDM field ID: PDVEVENTCFG.OPT:ALERT)
alert_duration Alert Duration integer Alert duration when configured PDV Event occures. Value in seconds. Only necessary if OPT:ALERT is set to Y
(PDM field ID: PDVEVENTCFG.ALERT:DURATION)
| bearb      | Modified by | char(10)  | Last editor       |     |
| ---------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------- | --- |
| bearb_date |             | date      | Last editing date |     |
| bearb_time |             | integer   | Last editing time |     |
| caption    | Caption     | char(100) |                   |     |
(PDM field ID: PDVEVENTCFG.CAPTION)
| category | Event category | char(20) |                                 |     |
| -------- | -------------- | -------- | ------------------------------- | --- |
| event    | Event Id       | char(50) | Unique event id, must be filled |     |
(PDM field ID: PDVEVENTCFG.EVENT)
| type       | Event type | char(1)  |                   |     |
| ---------- | ---------- | -------- | ----------------- | --- |

10.19. pdv_logic_chan
Table name: pdv_logic_chan Product: PDV
Designation: Logical Channels Description: PDV Logical Channels are the central configuration to assign physical channels (connectors) of
workplaces and terminals to a specific PDV element as processparameters or PDV Events.
Can be used to configure output and input data. The way to capture data can be specified as the type of data, too.
* Notes
With this configuration you can configure channles of different workplace/temrinal combination and the current activ
workplce <> terminal assignment will be used.
These are versioned master data tables with acuracy of seconds.
* Keys
(masch_nr, capture_id, chan_nr, fkey, type, chan_data, orientation, valid_from)
* logical connection to other tables
masch_nr can be joined with table maschinen.masch_nr
capture_id can be joined with terminals.terminalnr
fkey can be joined with pdv_event_cfg.event if type = 'E' or with caq_merkmal.messwerf_aut_art if type = 'PP'
Column name Column designation Type Description
active Active channel char(1) Defines whether current channel configuration is active and should be considered or not.
Possible values:
Y: Channel is active
N: Channel is not active
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.AKTIV)
alert Alert char(1) Defines whether the application should set an output signal if the specified channel data type (field: chan_data) is violated or
not.
Supported alues are:
Y: Yes, alert signal should be set on channel defined by field alert_chan_nr
N: No, no alert signal should be set
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.OPT:ALERT)
alert_chan_nr Alert Channel integer Defines on which physical channel an output signal should be set, if captured value violates channel data (field: chan_data).
Only neccessary if field alert is set to 'Y'
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.ALERTK)
bearb char(10)
bearb_date date
bearb_time integer
capture_id Terminal smallint Terminal, reference to master data table terminals
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.TNR)
chan_cap Channel Caption char(20) Channel Caption
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.KCAP)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 635

chan_data Data Type char(4) This field specifies which type of data the captured values will belog to. These can be the upper tolerance limit, upper process
intervention limit, setpoint/target value, lower process intervention limit, lower tolerance limit or measured value
The following values ar available:
Limits:
OTG - upper tolerance limit
OPEG - upper process intervention limit
UPEG - lower process intervention limit
UTG - lower tolerance limit
setpoint/target value
SW - setpoint/target value
Measure
MW - measured value
SW and MW can't be assigned if you are configuring a Channel with alert flag.
If the reference id points to an anonym processparameter, only MW is allowed, because anonym processparameters don't
contain any specifications.
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.KDATA)
chan_nr Channel Number integer Number of the physical channel to capture data of. Must be unique for every terminal - independant of assigned workplaces
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.LOGK)
chan_trigger Trigger number integer Channel number of physical channel, which initiates capturing current value of chan_nr.
Only necceassary if cah_typ = 'T'
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.TRIGGERK)
chan_type Physical Channel Type char(1) Defines which method for capturing values of the physical channel should be used. There are 3 supported types of tapping
values:
T: (Trigger-driven)
You can specify another physical channel number in field chan_trigger which will cause the PLC-Interface to capture current
value of channel defined in chan_nr
C: (Cyclic-driven)
You can specify a time interval in secondes in field cycle_time which will cause the PLC-Interface to capture current value of
channel definied in chan_nr every n seconds
A: (Automatic-driven)
Your machine connection allows you to transmit current data completly by itself - no trigger channel or timer is needed to
receive values from the PLC-Interface
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.KTYP)
cycle_time Time Intervall integer Intervall in seconds which definies the cycletime after which data of chan_nr will be stored. Only necessarry if chan_type = 'C'
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.TIMER)
data_type Data type char(1)
fkey Reference Id char(50) Reference which data that will be captures by the physical channel belongs to. This can be any PDV Events or any configured
Processparameters.
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.ID)
masch_nr Workplace char(20) Workplace reference to masterdata table maschinen
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.MNR)
orientation Data Direction char(1) Defines data exchange direction between application and maschine using PLC-Interface.
Supported values are:
I: (Input)
Data from machine to application
O: (Output)
Data from application to machine
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.ARTK)
type Reference Type char(2) Specifies whether the configured data id belongs to a PDV Event ('E') or to a Processparameter ('PP')
Possible Values are:
E - PDV Event
PP - Processparameter
(PDM field ID: LOGCHAN.TYP)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 636

10.29. tnt_columns
Table name: tnt_columns Product: PDV
Designation: Column configuration of TNT-Framework Description: Necessary table to configure all columns of a tnt table used to stored id or timebased data
* Notes
Entrys can not be changed after system installation. No User-Interface or BAPI-Interface available for table. Table will
only be chaneged during system installation!
* logical connection to other tables
Contains column information of tnt table which header is definied in tnt_headers
tht_columns.table_id = tnt_headers.table_id
Column name Column designation Type Description
anonym_object Anonym Object char(1) Defines whether this column contains a anonym object or not. Anonym object can be used by consumer application to capture
values without the need of configure corresponding objects in the consumer application.
Supported Values are:
Y: Yes
N: No (default)
For example the PDV consumer uses this field to capture PDV values without the need of configure a inspection plan
(PDM field ID: Anonym Object)
col_caption Column Caption char(50) Column Caption
(PDM field ID: Column Caption)
col_content Column Content char(20) Only necessary if col_type = D (default columns)
Contains information which data is stored in the column (e.g. workplace, capture_ts, ...) This field values are depending on
each application whcih is using TNT Framework.
(PDM field ID: Column Content)
col_datatype Column data type char(10) Defines which data type the coulmn should store.
Supported values are:
DECIMAL: floating point values
INTEGER: integer values
DATETIME: datetime values
CHAR: text values
(PDM field ID: Column data type)
col_field_type Column field type char(10) Optionally parameter for defining Field-Type of values that are stored in the column
(PDM field ID: Column field type)
col_format Column Format char(10) Optionally defines the display representation of the stored values of this column.
Supported values are:
TEXT: text representation
DATE: date representation
TIME: time representation
DATETIME: date and time representation
DECIMAL: floating point representation
HEX: hexadecimal representation
OKT: octal representation
BIN: binary representation
(PDM field ID: Column Format)
col_length Column Data Length integer Defines maximum data length of column data. Only necessary if col_datatype = CHAR
(PDM field ID: Column Data Length)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 648

col_name Column name char(18) Name of the column. Will be used in any SQL Command. So must be unique for each table id.
In use of time based tables the following name convention must be used:
value_[datatype] So there are 4 possible values / entries:
value_decimal, value_char, value_integer, value_datetime
(PDM field ID: Column name)
col_pos Column Position integer Position number of the column in the TNT Table. Must be unique for every table id and must be greater or equal value 0.
IMPORTANT: The values must be numbered consecutively.
(PDM field ID: Column Position)
col_type Column Type char(1) Defines whether the column stores normal data (captured values) or stroes default data (e.g. workplace id).
Supported Values are:
N: normal column (default value)
D: default column
(PDM field ID: Column Type)
index_pos Index Pos integer Optionally the position at which the configured column should be appear when defining an index for the table. If the entry is
empty, the column will not appear in the index.
IMPORTANT: If any value will be set in this field, all the values must be numbered consecutively.
(PDM field ID: Index Pos)
is_capture_ts Capture Timestamp char(1) Only for default columns necessary (col_typ = D)
Defines whether this column stores the capture timestamp of the values
Supported values are:
Y: Yes
N: No (default)
(PDM field ID: Capture Timestamp)
is_object_id Is Object Id char(1) Only for default columns necessary (col_typ = D)
Defines whether this column stores the object id of the values
Supported values are:
Y: Yes
N: No (default)
(PDM field ID: Is Object Id)
is_reference_id Is Reference Id char(1) Only for default columns necessary (col_typ = D)
Defines whether this column stores the reference id of the values
Supported values are:
Y: Yes
N: No (default)
(PDM field ID: Is Reference Id)
key_field Key Field char(1) Defines whether this column should be handled as key column or not. Consumer apllications of the TNT Framework can use
this configuration for filtering data in any analytic programms.
Supported values are:
Y: key field
N: no key filed (default value)
(PDM field ID: Key Field)
object_id Object Id char(50) Defines which object id will be stored in this column.
For example this can be a processparameter when using PDV as consumer application.The type of the object id is stored in
the tnt_headers.object_type column
(PDM field ID: Object Id)
passes_id Passes Id char(1) Configuration whether this column contains the passes number or not.
Supported values are:
Y: Yes
N: No (default)
(PDM field ID: Passes Id)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 649

reference_id Reference Id char(50) Reference id which informs the consumers which data is stored in this column.
For example this can be a machine number when using PDV as consumer application. The type of the reference id is stored in
the tnt_headers.reference_type column
(PDM field ID: Reference Id)
relation Relation char(50) Optionally relations to the system Objects can be defined in this field. This filed can only be filed for normal columns (col_type
= N).
For example you can assign values like CNR or AGNR. Theresponsibility for processing this value is up to the consumer
application.
(PDM field ID: HYDRA Relation)
| table_id | Table-Id | char(6) | System unique Table-Id |     |
| -------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------- | --- |
(PDM field ID: Table-Id)
tag_id Tag Id char(1) Defines whether this column contains the TNT Tag id. Only one column of any table id can be set as tag id.
Supported values are:
Y: Yes, column contains tag id
N:  No (default value)
(PDM field ID: Tag Id)

10.30. tnt_headers
Table name: tnt_headers Product: PDV
Designation: Table configuration of TNT-Framework Description: Provides functionality to configure table wide data, containing global informations like table type, or
which object types will be stored in this table.
* Keys
Table Id must be unique: unique index ixu_table_id on tnt_headers (table_id)
* logical connection to other tables
tnt_headers.table_id = tnt_columns.table_id (Reference to containing columns)
tnt_headers.table_id = tnt_table_repo.table_id (Reference to physical table management)
Column name Column designation Type Description
capture_type Capture Type char(4) Defines for which type to store data the current table should be configured.
The supported values are:
ID: id based data organisation, relational storing in horizontal direction
TIME: time based data organisation, relational storing in vertical direction (default)
(PDM field ID: Capture Type)
dbgroupname DB Groupname char(20) Provides possibility for consumer applications to define to which database groupname the table should belong to, if they
should be generated dynamically
(PDM field ID: DB Groupname)
def_idx_template Default Index Template char(1000) Provides template functionality for consumer applications.
Consumer apllication can insert a SQL Template written in SQL dialect for a second index statement the current table should
use.
There are the following place marker that can be used to replace for example tablename or index name:
%TABLENAME%: replace actual tablename
%INDEXNAME%: replace actual indexname
(PDM field ID: Default Index Template)
file_struc_time File structure time char(1) This field offers configuration possibilities for time structured table storage.
If consumer application stores data in time structured tables, they can also assign a time unit, by which the data should be
exported.
Supported values are:
N: No time structured table storage needed (default)
H: Hour - Exported files will be structured hourly
D: Day - Exported files will be structured daily
W: Week - Exported files will be structured weekly
M: Month - Exported files will be structured monthly
Y: Year - Exported files will be structured yearly
Note: file_structure_time can't contain a time unit with higher time range than the field tab_struc_time. Otherwise the values
will automatically be set as the same value than tab_struc_time
(PDM field ID: File structure time)
idx_template Index Template char(1000) Provides template functionality for consumer applications.
Consumer apllication can insert a SQL Template written in SQL dialect for the index statement the current table should use.
There are the following place marker that can be used to replace for example tablename or index name:
%TABLENAME%: replace actual tablename
%INDEXNAME%: replace actual indexname
(PDM field ID: Index Template)
indexspace Index Tablespace char(40) Provides possibility for consumer applications to define which table space should be used for indices when tables should be
created dynammically
(PDM field ID: Index Tablespace)
object_type Object Type char(20) Object type defines which type of objectes current configured table will store. It defines which object type the column
tnt_columns.object_id will store.
(PDM field ID: Object Type)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 652

reference_type Reference Type char(20) Object type defines which type of references the objectes of the current configured table will store.
It defines which reference type the column tnt_columns.reference_id will store.
(PDM field ID: Reference Type)
released Released char(1) Defines whether the current table configuration is completed and valid, so current system can use the configuration to store
and select data.
Note: After releasing a table configuration, no more changes of the table configuration are allowed.
Supported values are:
Y: Table configuration released and ready to be used
N: Table configuration not released yet (default)
(PDM field ID: Released)
tab_group Table group char(10) Text field to group structural identical table configurations. This field can be used by TNT-Frameworks kernel function to
optimize data selection algorithm
(PDM field ID: Table group)
tab_struc_time Table structure time char(1) This field offers configuration possibilities for time structured table storage.
If consumer application stores data in time structured tables, they can also assign a time unit, by which the data should be
exported.
Supported values are:
N: No time structured table storage needed (default)
H: Hour - Tables will be structured hourly
D: Day - Tables will be structured daily
W: Week - Tables will be structured weekly
M: Month - Tables will be structured monthly
Y: Year - Tables will be structured yearly
(PDM field ID: Table structure time)
table_id Table Ident char(6) Unique identification for tnt based stored data.
(PDM field ID: Table Ident)
table_template Table Template char(4000) Provides template functionality for consumer applications.
Consumer apllication can insert a SQL Template written in SQL dialect for the table structures the current table consists of.
There are the following place marker that can be used to replace for example tablename or index name:
%TABLENAME%: replace actual tablename
%INDEXNAME%: replace actual indexname
Note: Stores up to 4000 characters. If template length is higher then 4000 the add-on fields (table_template_x) can be used
when splitting the template statement
(PDM field ID: Table Template)
table_template_1 Table Template (1) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (1))
table_template_2 Table Template (2) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template_1 if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (2))
table_template_3 Table Template (3) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template_2 if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (3))
table_template_4 Table Template (4) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template_3 if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (4))
table_template_5 Table Template (5) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template_4 if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (5))
table_template_6 Table Template (6) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template_5 if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (6))
table_template_7 Table Template (7) char(4000) Template add-on column for column table_template_6 if text-length of statement template exceeds 4000 characters
(PDM field ID: Table Template (7))
tablespace Tablespace char(40) Provides possibility for consumer applications to define which table space should be used, when tables should be created
dynammically
(PDM field ID: Tablespace)

10.31. tnt_table_repo
Table name: tnt_table_repo Product: PDV
Designation: TNT Table Repository Description: TNT Table Repository stores any tables managed by TNT Framework. It offers the ability to select the
physical table name to a specific TNT table id for a defined time range. It also contains table status information like
how many records currently stored or if table data is already exported into data file.
Which this repository table the TNT Framework receives the ability to determine the table names for a time range.
* Notes
Some information are necessary for TNT Framework and some information are necessary for TNT's consumer
application
* Keys
unique keys: capture_ts_start, capture_ts_end, table_id
* logical connection to other tables
The table_id field is linked to tnt_headers.table_id, where the master data is configured.
Field arc_path is linked to hy_path.path
Column name Column designation Type Description
arc_path Export Path char(8) Reference to Path configuration (tnt_table_repo.arc_path = hy_path.path), containing information about the directory to the
exported data file.
TNT Importer uses this information together with tne field exportfile to find necessary export data file if a data import was
requested.
(PDM field ID: Export Path)
capture_ts_end Capture Timestamp End datetime Contains timestamp of first possibly last record of the stored table (tnt_table_repo.tablename)
Note: This date mustn't be the date of the last record, its only the first possibly timestamp value
Note: If there isn't any time splitted table holding used by TNT consumer application, the value '12/31/9999 23:59:59' should
be insert here
(PDM field ID: Capture Timestamp End)
capture_ts_start Capture Timestamp Start datetime Contains timestamp of first possibly occured record of the stored table (tnt_table_repo.tablename)
Note: This date mustn't be the date of the first record, its only the first possibly timestamp value
Note: If there isn't any time splitted table holding used by TNT consumer application, the value of installation date should be
insert here
(PDM field ID: Capture Timestamp Start)
count_rec Record Count integer Current record count of the stored table.
Consumer Application is responsible for updating this value and TNT Framework will just read the information.
(PDM field ID: Record Count)
exportfile Export File char(256) Contains name of the exportfile if table data is exported. (no path information, only filename is stored in this field)
(PDM field ID: Export File)
is_online Online Status char(1) Information if current table data is online or if the data is already exported.
Suppoerted values:
Y: table data is online
N: data of table currently not in database / not online
(PDM field ID: Online Status)
reload_duration Reload Duration integer Expected reload duration of the stored table.
Consumer Application is responsible for updating this value and TNT Framework will just read the information.
(PDM field ID: Reload Duration)
schemafile - for future use - char(256) - for future use -
(PDM field ID: - for future use -)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 656

Absence planings can be planned for
1) Single persons by personalnummer and bezug=PNR and wert (personalnummer is redundant. It can be used to join
numerical)
2) Companies by firma and bezug=<null>

verweis

(PDM field ID: DAT:REF)
tagestypen Day types char(1999) Character string with 1464 characters.
Year Models: Year models have 365 or 366 blocks of four characters. Each 4 characters represent one day in the
year/week/period. The character string starts with a separator (|) for year models. For day type numbers from 1000 on the pipe
is replaced by the first digit of the type number,
Week models have 28 blocks of 5 characters (7 for normal days, 7 for public holidays, 7 for important public holidays and7 for
other days off). Each day type has four characters. The 5. character is a separator (|).
Period models have 1 to n blocks of five pipe seperated strings with dynamic width. The 5 pipe seperated values correspond
to the definiton of period models:
1) Number of days of the period element
2) Day type for normal days
3) Day type for public holidays
4) Day type for important public holidays
5) Day type for other days off
(PDM field ID: GLZJMOD.MODELL)
| verantw_bereich | Responsibility area | char(15) |     |     |
| --------------- | ------------------- | -------- | --- | --- |

Designation: Wage type competition and additions Description: In this table wage types can be defined competitively and in addition to each other. In case of competitive
wage types only one of the two wage types can be posted at a time. If both wage types are posted at the same time the
"weak" wage type is hidden by the "strong" one. In case of complementary wage types, the time that is posted with the
two source wage types is, instead of that, posted with the target wage type.

tagestypen Day types char(1999) Character string with 1464 characters.
Year Models: Year models have 365 or 366 blocks of four characters. Each 4 characters represent one day in the
year/week/period. The character string starts with a separator (|) for year models. For day type numbers from 1000 on the pipe
is replaced by the first digit of the type number,
Week models have 28 blocks of 5 characters (7 for normal days, 7 for public holidays, 7 for important public holidays and7 for
other days off). Each day type has four characters. The 5. character is a separator (|).
Period models have 1 to n blocks of five pipe seperated strings with dynamic width. The 5 pipe seperated values correspond
to the definiton of period models:
1) Number of days of the period element
2) Day type for normal days
3) Day type for public holidays
4) Day type for important public holidays
5) Day type for other days off
(PDM field ID: ENTLJMOD.MODELL)

12.22. lohnartengruppe

| Table name: lohnartengruppe |     | Product: PZE |     |     |
| --------------------------- | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: Wage type groups Description: In this table wage types can be summarized to groups for certain evaluations (e.g. configurable wage type
list).
| Column name | Column designation | Type | Description |     |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ---- | ----------- | --- |
abgelehnte Rejected postings char(1) Determination whether refused postings are to be displayed ("X"/"-")
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.OPT:REJECT)
| anlage      | Created by    | char(10) | For future use |     |
| ----------- | ------------- | -------- | -------------- | --- |
| anlage_date | Created date  | date     | For future use |     |
| anlage_time | Created time  | integer  | For future use |     |
| bearb       | Modified by   | char(10) |                |     |
| bearb_date  | Modified date | date     |                |     |
| bearb_time  | Modified time | integer  |                |     |
bezeichnung Designation char(40) The designation of the wage type group has to be entered in each data record of the group.
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.BEZ)
genehmigte Approved postings char(1) ("X"/"-") approved postings are considered in the group.
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.OPT:SIGN)
gr_lohnart Wage type group char(4) Indicator for the wage type group (group wage type).
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.LARTGRP)
herkunft Origin char(1) Origin of data (‚T'=daily wage type postings, ‚M'=monthly wage types)
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.OPT:TYP)
| kz  |     | char(1) | For future use |     |
| --- | --- | ------- | -------------- | --- |
lohnart char(4) Indicator of a wage type contained in the group.
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.LART)
| lohnart_text |     | smallint | Not used at the moment |     |
| ------------ | --- | -------- | ---------------------- | --- |
normale Postings that do not require approval char(1) ("X"/"-") postings that are not subject to authorization are considered in the group.
(PDM field ID: LARTGRP.OPT:NORM)

# Special remarks
This table contains both general settings and personal settings.
General settings have bezug='GLOBAL' and persoenlich=N.
Personal settings have persoenlich=J and key/value pairs in bezug/wert.
Personnel selection can be:
1) Global: bezug='GLOBAL', persoenlich=N
2) Single persons: personalnummer=<personnel no>,  bezug=<null>, wert=<personnel no>, persoenlich=J
2) Several other personnel selections: [firmen_nummer=<company>] (optional), bezug=<personnel selection key>,
wert=<personnel selection value>, persoenlich=J
# Key
<Key fields for unique access>
# Connections to other tables
If the personnel number is assigned an outer-join to the HR master can be made.

Designation: Personal day types / personal models Description: Personal day types / personal models
# Special remarks
This table is used for both personal day types and personal models, see column geloescht.
Personal day types and personal models can be planned for
1) Single persons by personalnummer and bezug=PNR and wert (personalnummer is redundant. It can be used to join
numerical)
2) Companies by firma and bezug=<null>
3) Several other combinations of bezug/wert
The fields firma, bereicht and kistenstelle are filled in additionally when bezug/wert refer to these attributes.

Designation: Clocking records Description: Entry of clocking times that are reported by the terminal. In each case a clocking-in time and a clocking-
out time is saved within a data record as a pair of clockings.
# Special remarks
Single clockings are combined into pairs. Data of clock in is stored in columns *_1, data of clock out is stored in
columns *_2.
As long as single clocking events cannot be combined into pairs columns *_1 and *_2 contain the same values (time of
clock in = time of clock out).
Wther the pair is complete or not is indicated by column bedeutung.
# Keys:
personalnummer, stempeldatum_1
personalnummer, aw_tag
verweis (unique)
# Connections to other tables
personen.personalnummer = personalnummer and stempeldatum_2 between personen.gueltig_von and
personen.gueltig_bis

The labor time calculation creates a data record for each employee and for every day. If the labor time calculation is

schwelle3 Threshold value for level 3 integer Threshold value for level 3
(PDM field ID: RESWART.WARTG:3)
wart_id Consecutive number of maintenance activi serial Consecutive number of maintenance activity
(PDM field ID: RESWART.VERWEIS)
wartungsart Maintenance type char(2) A = number (only with alarm management)
T = based on cycles
B = operating hours
Z = based on time(days)
K = vi calendar (level 2)
-> K and A are not supported in level 1
"Next maintenance": Determine the "color" of each maintenance (depending on threshold values - compare section 2.6.2
below the table); red means highest priority; light green means lowest priority.; within a color the priority depends on the
maintenance type: A (highest priority) -> T -> B -> Z -> K (lowest priority); thus the "next maintenance" can be determined
(PDM field ID: RESWART.ART)
zustand Maintenance condition integer Current maintenance condition
0 : green
1 : blue
2 : yellow
3 : red
This field is set by the cyclical process when reaching the respective threshold value (RES_WART) and it is reset due to the
dialog RES_WART_RUECK
(PDM field ID: RESWART.WARTSTA)
(C) MPDV Datum: 10.02.2021 808

14.16. zks_zz_bereich

| Table name: zks_zz_bereich |     | Product: ZKS |     |     |
| -------------------------- | --- | ------------ | --- | --- |
Designation: Acesss periods Description: This table contains the single acesss periods of the access time modles (table zks_zeitzonen).
Access time modles and their corresponding access periods are connected by zks_zeitzonen.verweis =
zks_zz_bereich.verw_zeitzonen.
| Column name | Column designation | Type | Description |     |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ---- | ----------- | --- |
abfrage_ausweis Badge required char(1) This field determines if the badge is to be checked within the time interval (J/N).
(PDM field ID: ZZB.PLAUS:KNR)
abfrage_pincode Pincode required char(1) This field defines whether the pin code is to be checked or not within this time interval (J/N). If neither the badge nor the pin
code is checked the access is permanently open.
(PDM field ID: ZZB.PLAUS:PIN)
| anlage      | Created by    | char(10) | For future use |     |
| ----------- | ------------- | -------- | -------------- | --- |
| anlage_date | Created date  | date     | For future use |     |
| anlage_time | Created time  | integer  | For future use |     |
| bearb       |               | char(10) | Last editor    |     |
| bearb_date  | Modified date | date     |                |     |
| bearb_time  | Modified time | integer  |                |     |
bis_zeit To integer End time in seconds since the beginning of the day
(PDM field ID: ZZB.ZEIE)
| buerofreigabe | Office unlocked | char(1) |     |     |
| ------------- | --------------- | ------- | --- | --- |
| kfz_erkennung |                 | char(1) |     |     |
kon_tag char(10) Definition of weekdays and public holidays when this time domain applies:
1st character = Sunday
...
7th character = Saturday
8 th character = Public holiday
9 th character = Important public holiday
10 th character = Other days off
| protokollierung | Logging | char(1) | N: No logging |     |
| --------------- | ------- | ------- | ------------- | --- |
V: Log access attempts only
Z: Log accesses and access attempts
(PDM field ID: ZZB.PLAUS:PRO)
| reserve |     | char(10) | For future use |     |
| ------- | --- | -------- | -------------- | --- |
verw_zeitzonen Reference to time zones integer Assignment to the unique record number within the table zks_zeitzonen.
(PDM field ID: ZZB.VERWEIS:ZZ)
verweis Reference serial Unique record number to access the data record
von_zeit Time integer Start time in seconds since the beginning of the day
(PDM field ID: ZZB.ZEIB)
